listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Cuir InfraRouge Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Maison Crivelli presents its seventh extrait de parfum, Cuir InfraRouge, developed in collaboration with perfumer Jordi Fernandez. For this new opus, Thibaud Crivelli was inspired by the taste of a raspberry cocktail while attending an electronic music festival. "With Cuir InfraRouge, my intention was to bring back to life fun memories, when I attended music festivals while sipping raspberry cocktails, which are among my favourites. This creation is a delight. It sees an incredible contrast between a young, vibrant, luminous and nearly fluorescent raspberry accord on one side, and a deep, comforting and sophisticated leather accord on the other. I find Cuir InfraRouge to be an unprecedented take on leather, the one I had always dreamt of creating." Thibaud Crivelli’s vivid experience is the inspiration for Cuir InfraRouge extrait de parfum, a supple leather illuminated by a fluorescent raspberry. This vibrant contrast sets the tone from the very first notes, an invigorating cocktail blending a raspberry accord and fresh, juicy citruses. The heart sees cedarwood coupled with the powdery notes of orris and cinnamon, while osmanthus brings leather and apricot tones. The drydown is built on a beautiful combination of leather suede accord, oud and patchouli. Vanilla prolongs the elegance of the creation with its addictive and intoxicating warmth. Maison Crivelli was created with the aim of surprising people with gender-neutral, daring olfactory creations that defy conventions and stand out from the classics. Each fragrance in the collection encapsulates adventures experienced by the brand's founder, Thibaud Crivelli. Scents, colours, sounds and textures intermingle to capture the essence of surprise, a challenge to the ordinary and an invitation to explore new sensory frontiers.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Cuir InfraRouge Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Maison Crivelli presents its seventh extrait de parfum, Cuir InfraRouge, developed in collaboration with perfumer Jordi Fernandez. For this new opus, Thibaud Crivelli was inspired by the taste of a raspberry cocktail while attending an electronic music festival. "With Cuir InfraRouge, my intention was to bring back to life fun memories, when I attended music festivals while sipping raspberry cocktails, which are among my favourites. This creation is a delight. It sees an incredible contrast between a young, vibrant, luminous and nearly fluorescent raspberry accord on one side, and a deep, comforting and sophisticated leather accord on the other. I find Cuir InfraRouge to be an unprecedented take on leather, the one I had always dreamt of creating." Thibaud Crivelli’s vivid experience is the inspiration for Cuir InfraRouge extrait de parfum, a supple leather illuminated by a fluorescent raspberry. listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Vétiver Le Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Synonymous with strength, strongly concentrated parfum offers the boldest expression of a fragrance. To reinterpret Vétiver’s iconic fragrance, Guerlain’s perfumers have turned to the world of spirits as an inspiration. Drawing upon the emblematic notes and the spellbinding yet bold aesthetic of this world that shares so much with perfumery, this spray fragrance is crafted from an exceptional selection of highly concentrated ingredients, to create a scent of unparalleled seduction. Noble. powerful, intense. Composed much like a gin, Vétiver Le Parfum opens with slightly bitter, aromatic notes of juniper berry. Invigorating and energising, an exceptional vetiver essence follows, revealing its freshest facets. Distilled from vetiver roots, this noble ingredient showcases the full depth of vetiver’s woody tones. Blended with captivating smoky notes and the addictive Tonka bean, beloved by Guerlain, the result is a fragrance that reveals a sublime balance of brightness and earthiness, power and elegance. A square, faceted, streamlined bottle. Maintaining the same strong and sleek lines of its Guerlain heritage, Vétiver Le Parfum’s bottle takes on a bolder look with a darker green label that reflects the power and concentration of the bewitching fragrance. With a nod to the world of watchmaking, the heavy matte cap features a guilloche pattern.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Him Bleu Noir Parfum 50ml
listings.description: For Him Bleu Noir Parfum is a new creation for a man who defines his own singularity. Mysterious and audacious, this new bleu noir fragrance revisits masculine elegance by exploring a new complementary universe within the for him franchise. Bleu Noir Parfum embodies a warm, amber, and utterly addictive fragrance. In this new fragrance, suede leather is enhanced by the sensuality of iris and sweetened by the addiction of tonka. The heart of musk, the brand's signature, evokes the sensuality and luxuriousness of Bleu Noir which is truly unforgettable. Regarding the design, for the first time, the iconic bottle of bleu noir is unveiled without interior lacquering, revealing an elegant blue hue with a translucent black outer lacquering. Lastly, a matte navy cap brings the final touch of sensuality. An iconic design that expresses mystery and intensity.

listings.rawTitle: LOEWE Aire Sutileza Elixir Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: LOEWE Aire Sutileza Elixir Eau de Parfum for women reinterprets the original fragrance with a higher, more resonant concentration of essential oils. As a standout in the LOEWE Botanical Rainbow Elixir collection, this floral perfume is inspired by the pure and fresh air all around us, uplifting, elemental, and life-giving. It captures a sense of freedom, resilience, and vitality in a scent that is both delicate and profound. The fragrance is characterised by a floral, fruity, and musky notes profile that opens with a vibrant, crisp blend of cassis, bergamot, lemon, and pear. As the scent develops, a refined heart of orange flower, magnolia, jasmine sambac, peony, and muguet emerges. This complex women's perfume is anchored by a deep, earthy base of vetiver, sandalwood, and musks, all enriched by the raw and authentic LOEWE Accord, an exclusive note created by our perfumer and centred on the resinous Spanish Rockrose wildflower that defines the brand's olfactory DNA. The LOEWE Aire Sutileza Elixir experience is housed in the signature block-shaped glass flask, featuring a beautiful leaf-green gradient and topped with a tactile wenge wooden cap that echoes the natural inspiration of the scent. Whether you seek a perfume with sandalwood and musk for depth, or a fruity perfume with pear and magnolia for freshness, the LOEWE Aire Sutileza Elixir EDP provides a resonant, long-lasting, and authentic sensory journey of the LOEWE DNA.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum For Women 30ml
listings.description: Escape into a joy-fuelled fantasy land with Gucci Flora. Evolving into a delicious Eau de Parfum fragrance, floral yet delicately sweet, Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia relaunches in a campaign filled with flowers and fluffy animals. A signature floral scent for all free-spirited women full of positive energy. This perfume for women is built around the Gardenia flower, admired since the dawn of time for its splendour and said to be used in elixirs and magical potions. Taking inspiration from this legend and the idea of its mystical power, the gorgeous White Gardenia note is blended with solar Jasmine Grandiflorum absolute. This delicious potion of joy is introduced by a cheerful Pear Blossom accord while a touch of Brown Sugar accord adds a delicate sweetness to its scent trail. Encased within a new, elongated bottle, the lacquered pink glass and shiny gold cap make it an object of beauty. One notable addition is the House’s distinctive Flora pattern, reimagined with a design inspired by Alessandro Michele’s vision. A core part of the Gucci identity, the motif is a painting of colourful flowers by artist Vittorio Accornero, created for Gucci in 1966. Directed and shot by artist Petra Collins and fronted by artist, actor, trailblazer and philanthropist Miley Cyrus, The #FloraFantasy campaign is a journey through a candy pink world, inspired by Japanese anime and filled with pop references where more is more. "The Flora Gorgeous Gardenia campaign is a challenge to reinterpret the world of flowers in an unexpected way. The inspiration comes from Miley Cyrus, an artist with a spirit that is both rock ‘n’ roll and eclectic at the same time... Because who says that someone with a rock ‘n’ roll attitude can’t live in a world of flowers and embody the Flora universe?" Alessandro Michele.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Eau de Parfum For Her 30ml
listings.description: The new chapter of Gucci Guilty signature fragrances revels in the notion of women who are truly liberated. A modern declaration of self-expression and fearlessness burns brightly in the new powerful statement #ForeverGuilty. Blended for the new revolution, the Gucci Guilty for her scent is reborn, an Amber Floral that brings richness and nobility to the original eau de toilette. Superior floral notes and enhanced natural fragrances flourish into a strong and refined eau de parfum. The perfume is intensified, with a higher perfume concentrated than the classic eau de toilette, radiating with commanding ingredients Mandora, Pink Pepper, Lilac and Patchouli. Opening in the mood of the scent’s message, a top note experience is redolent with the citrus notes of Mandora - a fruit found in the Mediterranean island of Cyprus smoothed out with natural Bergamot and Pink Pepper. The heart defines the scent’s new complexity. Lilac is contrasted with rosy and violet notes and layered with Geranium Oil to create a nuanced and individual floral blend. Defining the scent: a deep natural duet of Patchouli Oils; Patchouli Coeur and Patchouli oil Micro-Distillation combined with Ambery notes, which leave an enduring silage - the time the perfume’s fragrance lingers in the air when worn.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Kalan Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Intense and subtle at once, Kalan is an olfactory signature that surprises with a sparkling opening, blending black pepper and spices with fresh notes of blood orange. The Parfums de Marly Eau de Parfum is anchored with a heart of orange blossom and lavender, and while it evolves, facets of white sandalwood unfold and drape into notes of moss and precious wood. The result is an olfactory narrative that is round with clear, seductive top notes and simultaneously an immediately discernible base. The harmony between the materials and the accords creates this olfactory music that is the signature of Kalan. Olfactive notes: Top notes: Blood Orange, Black Pepper, Spices Heart notes: Lavender, Solar notes, Orange Blossom Absolute Base notes: Precious Wood, Oakmoss, White Sandalwood Revolutionary in its aesthetic, fluctuating between shadow and light and rebelling against current fragrance trends, Kalan is a unique creation that resides on the margins of the olfactory family, a revisited Fougere. Captivating luxury in its gleaming ardent red attire, this contemporary Parfums de Marly eau de parfum is a best seller and made for the lover of rare materials and ultimate exhilaration.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Quercus Eau de Cologne, 100ml
listings.description: A cologne of some sophistication, named for the iconic English oak. Basil and lemon as fresh as a mountain stream, sweet jasmine, and a woody, mossy depth that brings one happily back to earth. Key notes: mandarin, lily Of The Valley, oakmoss. "Quercus is a joyful burst of citrus and basil, supported by jasmine, cardamom, lily and amber. These are warmed through with moss and patchouli to create an elegant, transparent and uplifting cologne."

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne PHANTOM IN RED Parfum Elixir 50ml
listings.description: For nearly six decades, Rabanne has been a pioneering force. Renowned for its avant–garde fashion and audacious fragrances, it continually challenges conventions and pushes the limits of radical self–expression. Disruptive. Empowering. Cutting edge. The Maison continues that legacy, trailblazing a new era in beauty. Created to define a new world order for a defiantly rebellious tribe, Rabanne Beauty inspires new generations to push the limits of creativity. From Fashion to Beauty, from Paris to the world, it addresses those who dare to express who they are. If love is a game, he breaks all the rules. Rabanne’s irresistible night owl with a rock and roll soul returns to rule the city of love – but this time, he’s truly, madly in love. With PHANTOM IN RED Parfum Elixir, PHANTOM’s signature lavender is reinvented in a potent, masculine, amber aromatic woody fragrance. Made for men who are born to stand out, PHANTOM IN RED forms the ultimate power couple with FAME IN LOVE Parfum Elixir. Inspired by love, PHANTOM IN RED’s addictive lavender is turned into a potent elixir by the ambery woody inflexions of smoky benzoin and sensual saffron.

With PHANTOM IN RED Parfum Elixir, PHANTOM’s signature lavender is reinvented in a potent, masculine, amber aromatic woody fragrance. Made for men who are born to stand out, PHANTOM IN RED forms the ultimate power couple with FAME IN LOVE Parfum Elixir. Inspired by love, PHANTOM IN RED’s addictive lavender is turned into a potent elixir by the ambery woody inflexions of smoky benzoin and sensual saffron.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Heavenly Gingerlily Eau De Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Entice the senses with the delicately floral notes of this alluring eau de parfum. Fresh ginger and cardamom intermingle with tuberose and lily, deepened with an olfactive signature of hyacinth. How to use: Spray all over the body as desired. Use on pulse points for a longer-lasting scent.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Him Musc Santal Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: The For Him collection by Narciso Rodriguez is a tribute to the strength of modern masculinity, in all its duality. For Him Musc Santal Eau de Parfum Intense reveals a new intensified masculinity, in a story of contrasts where assertive self-confidence meets sensitive authenticity, for the man who attracts with his natural charm. An understated force, with a powerful aura. Working alongside Narciso Rodriguez, renowned perfumer Florian Gallo has crafted a woody musky perfume for men, composed around the magnetic sensuality of musk. This vegan fragrance opens with the clear freshness of clary sage and juniper top notes. At the core, the powerful character of the Narciso Rodriguez heart of musc signature reveals its paradoxical nature: clean yet animalic, pure yet mysterious. At the base, woody notes of cedarwood and sandalwood create extra contrast. A perfume that juxtaposes the duality of warm and cold to create an addictively seductive tension. A design contrasting cool grey with warm wood: For this masculine perfume, the geometric bottle is infused with the subtle strength of frosted grey, and the cap is crafted from natural wood. The outer box features a textured wood-grain effect.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Like the cut of a dress, this fragrance is shaped with all of Guerlains’ finesse. Its simple signature enhances and romances several exceptional materials in a bold overdose. Black cherry blinks the first wink. It is illustrated by a clever blend that extends exquisite almond and delicious berries. The second wink takes place as rose enters the stage. Finally, the shadowy temptations of licorice and smoky black tea reveal more of me and lead to irresistible seduction. For the ultimate temptation, the entire creation is wrapped in Guerlinade. Fresh, enigmatic and exhilarating… Mischievous and captivating… I am the warm spark beneath the sweetness. I am absolutely essential and utterly irresistible. I am the chic and very seductive, perfumed creation by Guerlain.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Love Frequency Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: “A flash of addictive pink pepper, rose ultimate and spicy, sultry saffron feels like a warm embrace that attracts the purest love to you and everyone around you! “Blended with sensual musks, alluring ambery woods and intoxicating patchouli heart, it elicits feelings of love to make your heart dance, leaving a love scent trail in its path that lasts up to 18 hours! “Love Frequency wholly encapsulates the encounter of the romantic rose, queen of the flowers, dancing in perfect harmony with the euphoric and spicy facets of pink pepper! “A vibrant union between bold patchouli, sensual woody notes, and velvety addictive musks, Love Frequency is the alluring and perfect scent of eternal and all-encompassing love. Boost your feelings of love with the emotion-boosting molecules of love frequency!” Charlotte Tilbury. This is a love portal in a bottle. Discover Charlotte’s vision of a modern rose, the flower of love! Powered by love emotion-boosting molecules, hypnotic rose essential and warm cashmere wood, that bathe you in the glow of love. Floral, soft and delicately hypnotic, this enchanting fragrance radiates love. It’s that all-encompassing, comforting feeling of being in love and being loved. How does Love Frequency enhance feelings of love? Charlotte had a specific vision in mind - working with scientist Céline Manetta at IFF, the IFF Scentcube™ algorithm was able to identify the perfect combination of notes to create a fragrance that helps boost feelings of universal love - from friendship to romance to familial love and self-love. Love Frequency emanates that all-encompassing feeling of being loved and being in love. 84% agree the fragrance enhances feelings of love 82% agree the fragrance enhances feelings of romance 81% agree the fragrance enhances feelings of inner love *Tested on 104 people over 1 week. Emotion-boosting molecules: Hypnotic rose essential Warm cashmere wood Olfactive family: Floral Woody. Magic fragrance notes: Top notes: Addictive Pink Pepper Heart notes: Sultry Saffron, Romantic Rose Ultimate Extract, Hypnotic Rose Essential Base notes: Sensual Musk, Warm Cashmere Wood, Captivating Ambery Woods, Intoxicating Patchouli Heart

listings.description: Tobacco Vanille brown and gold-tone atomiser with magnetic closure features Tobacco Vanille in a 10ml vial. The opulent artisanal scent features tobacco and warm and sweet gourmands. TOM FORD's affection for London and an English gentleman's club filled with rich spices and cognacs. Tobacco Vanille is opulent, warm and iconic. Reminiscent of an English Gentleman’s Club and blended with rich spices, vanilla and tobacco flower, it leaves a powerful impression.” TOM FORD.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense, 75ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense embodies bold femininity. Its olfactory signature plays with refined contrasts, blending the power of intense and radiant notes with the softness of gentler accents, creating a sophisticated and elegant composition that leaves a lasting impression. The design: The design of the Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense bottle reinterprets the essential lines of the original The One, revealing its rich amber tones and enveloping essence. The fragrance was created by Quentin Bisch exclusively for Dolce & Gabbana. Fragrance notes: Top notes: A vibrant touch of Pink Pepper opens the composition with a multifaceted, energising, and unexpected Heart notes: At the heart, Jasmine unveils a luminous floral sensuality - elegant and magnetic Base notes: In the base, creamy Vanilla blends with warm, ambery accords, leaving a rich and lasting trail on the skin

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Mandarine Basilic Forte Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Mandarine Basilic Forte, a golden mandarin paired with vibrant basil, beautifully enhanced by the warmth of sandalwood and the delicious vanilla tincture. Aqua Allegoria Forte, a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. Create your own olfactory signature by pairing Mandarine Basilic Forte with Nerolia Vetiver, Bergamote Calabria, Rosa Rossa, Nettare Di Sole or Flora Cherrysia. Select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Pure Musc Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A supremely addictive scent, For Her PURE MUSC Eau de Parfum teases the senses and envelops the body. It is a provocative play on purity. Worn alone, For Her PURE MUSC Eau de Parfum is pure addiction. When layered with other For Her fragrances, For Her PURE MUSC Eau de Parfum is more personal and most memorable. The Fragrance: Narciso Rodriguez’s signature musc is reinterpreted and refined with a disarming purity and a rich depth. With For Her PURE MUSC, the sublime heart of musc is enhanced with a white floral bouquet. Cashmeran added to the base lends warmth to the perfume. Witness a fragrance that maintains a sophisticated delicateness amidst all of its strength. The Bottle: The black and white bottle echoes the exquisite artistry and beauty of the fragrance within. The frosted white lacquer against a strong black cap continues its story of strength mixed with softness. Olfactory Family: Musky Chypre. Top Notes: Jasmin and Orange Blossom Heart Notes: Heart of Musc Base Notes: Cashmeran, Amber and Patchouli The Fragrance Ritual: Combine For Her PURE MUSC with For Her Eau de Parfum. Live an addiction of musc and peach to feel seductive Combine For Her PURE MUSC with For Her Eau de Toilette. Live an addiction of musk and white flowers to feel sophisticated Combine For Her PURE MUSC with For Her fleur musc. Live an addiction of musk and spicy rose to feel daring

listings.rawTitle: Sisley-Paris L'Eau Rêvée d'Eliya Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Dreams inspire our creativity, they nourish us with images, memories and sensations. Les Eaux Rêvées express this imaginary place where inspirations collide, join together and become one – the inspirations of different generations of the d’Ornano family, the creators of Sisley. This collection is made up of six mixed fragrances, olfactory odes with a perfect, ambivalent nature. A tropical bouquet after the rain: L’Eau Rêvée d’Eliya revisits a tropical forest and imagines a utopian jungle, vibrant after the rain: a new and innocent garden, filled with mythical birds and unknown sounds. Its atmosphere intriguing, warm and perfumed, is the starting point for a radiant juice combining exotic flowers with tuberose and violet. Designed in collaboration with two artists, Elżbieta Radziwiłł et Bronisław Krzysztof, L'Eau Rêvée d'Eliya transports us into the world of unknown, distant and mysterious dreams. Canson paper case and glass bottle made in France. Case and bottle are recyclable. Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Exotic Flowers accord Middle notes: Tuberose, Violet, Jasmin Base notes: Amber, Cedarwood, Patchouli

listings.description: For this Festive Season, Parfums de Marly invites you on a celestial journey inspired by the first hot-air balloon ascent above the Marly domaine, through this exceptional Valaya gift set. Elegant, delicate and sensual, Valaya evokes cotton caressing the skin with crisp mandarin, creamy white flowers, and rich akigalawood, melting into a trail of musks. Set contains: Valaya Eau de Parfum, 75ml Valaya Hair Perfume, 75ml Valaya Refillable Body Cream, 200ml

listings.rawTitle: Hermès H24 Eau de Parfum Natural Spray, Refillable 50ml
listings.description: Created by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, H24 Eau de Parfum reveals a new energy that is characterised by its intensity. A woody aromatic, H24 Eau de Parfum unfurls the rich, botanical power of enveloping sage, the density of high-tech moss and the warm vibrancy of sclarene. To echo the fragrance’s olfactory notes, the bottle with its aerodynamic lines designed by Philippe Mouquet is adorned with moss-green lacquer. The intense grey of the box is defined by a fine lime-green line that opens up the space. The bottle is refillable and made from recycled glass. The box is made entirely of untreated paper and is also composed of recycled fibres. H24 opens up a new space. H for Hermès, Homme and Hours. 24 to evoke a relationship with time and a link to the house’s flagship address of 24 rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré.

listings.rawTitle: Rituals Private Collection Suede Vanilla Home Perfume, 400ml
listings.description: The Suede Vanilla home fragrance from our Private Collection has a warm and aromatic scent of fresh sage, soothing vanilla, and creamy sandalwood, filling any room with a sense of serenity. Beautifully presented in a reusable glass bottle, specially designed to complement our scented candles and reed diffusers. How to use: Diffuse a few sprays in the air and enjoy a delightful fragrance. When the bottle is empty, simply refill it with your favourite home fragrance refill.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Mon Guerlain fragrances are a fragrant manifesto of today's femininity. A multi-faceted woman: strong, free and sensual. Discover Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet, a smiling fruity fresh amber. The fragrance impression of a radiant personality. A fragrance faceted like a jewel, which revisits Mon Guerlain’s essential ingredients in a fruity and intensely luminous register. The essential lavender-vanilla duo is beautifully enhanced by a sparkling pear note and a luminous Sambac jasmine. A captivating fruity fresh amber sillage with a magnetic charm. "It’s a pear-lavender sorbet which melts onto burnt vanilla." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. The 'quadrilobe' bottle, created in 1908, established itself as one of Guerlain’s iconic bottles. Simple and graphic, it echoes an alchemist’s bottle and owes its name 'quadrilobe' to its stopper, which is formed from one piece to obtain a shape resembling four lobes. One century later, beautifully enhanced by a luxurious glass weight and a golden adornment, this bottle offers a contrast between strong taut lines and sensual curves, expressing contemporary femininity. How to use: Spray Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet on pulse points.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette, 90ml
listings.description: A vibrant, fresh, floral scent from the glamorous Italian fashion house. Bright Crystal is bursting with juicy notes of pomegranate, pretty magnolia, peony and lotus flowers with amber and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Cannabis Santal Eau de Parfum
listings.description: A woody blend of earthy cannabis and patchouli. Let a seductive memory linger with our woody fragrance Cannabis Santal Eau de Parfum, featuring sensual notes of earthy cannabis, patchouli, and vetiver. This intoxicating, forbidden fragrance is enclosed in an apothecary-style glass bottle. The smell of smoky woods and sensual patchouli still lingers in the air, transporting you back to the night before. A seductive cannabis accord sprinkled with the rind of an orange has become your obsession. Lev Glazman, Fresh co-founder. Fragrance notes: Top: Plum, Bergamot, Italian Orange Middle: Patchouli, Earthy cannabis, Rose Bottom: Vanilla, Musk, Dark Chocolate, Vetiver How to use: Spray on the inside of your wrists, the back of your neck, below the centre collarbone, or on either side of your shoulders. When layered with another fresh fragrance, alternate the location of each scent.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum intensifies the radiance of the three auras found in this woody, ambery floral perfume, without betraying the original inspiration of the eau de parfum. The perfumer’s mastered craft and the wisdom gained with time gave birth to this woody perfume extract, an ultimate accomplishment for Francis Kurkdjian. The Grandiflorum jasmine perfume creates head notes that gently underscores the craftsman’s voice. The hint of fire is enhanced with powdered epicurean facets of bitter almond. Lastly, the mineral note built around ambergris is tamed with a musky and woody accord. Adding to the intensity of this bouquet perfume, the bottle also plays with light. Its aesthetic dons a brilliant red robe reminiscent of Baccarat red. Collection: YSL Beauty mixes ingredients and proportions, constantly re-interpreting Black Opium’s coffee signature. Discover the YSL Black Opium fragrance wardrobe and indulge yourself or treat others to a YSL Black Opium gift. Black Opium Eau de Parfum. The original Eau de Parfum. Extra-black coffee, ultra-white flowers, and an abundance of patchouli. Exhilarating and excessive Black Opium Eau de Parfum Intense. A bold interpretation of the Black Opium’s coffee note, enhanced by the thrilling aura of blue absinthe for intensity. Deep and seductive

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 + Champaca Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: The most minimal fragrance is a single aroma-molecule: Molecule 01. The next most minimal adds 1 to 01: 01 + 1. This is Molecule +. The M+ line adds +1 to Iso E Super, the super aroma-molecule that turned the cloistered world of perfumery upside down. Molecule 01 + Champaca consists of Iso E Super + Champaca. Iso E Super is an abstract synthetic molecule characterised as a cedarwood note with a warm, woody, velvety cocooning sensation. Champaca is an absolute extracted from the red champaca flower, found only in India. One of the most expensive ingredients in perfumery, champaca absolute is one of the richest, most faceted floral materials in perfumery, with shades of jasmine and orange blossom, touches of tea, and a soft creaminess that unfolds in waves. Together, Iso E Super and champaca form an unexpected harmony: the weightless transparency of Iso E Super against the intricate opulence of champaca. A radiant opening with hints of orange blossom brightness gives way to a heart that is lush, floral, woody, and quietly exotic, before settling into the smooth, woody embrace of Molecule 01. "I was overwhelmed when I first smelled champaca absolute with Molecule 01. Champaca absolute and Iso E Super form an amazing amalgamation, because they are very contrary. Champaca absolute has so many facets. It's so rich. There's so much happening in it. The complexity of champaca absolute complements Iso E Super exceptionally well on its own. Because Iso E Super has these very woody yet transparent, very velvety, very cocooning, soft aspects, and then you have champaca, giving it all this complexity, all these different olfactory sensations," says Geza Schoen. M+ Champaca is an opulent yet weightless fragrance, where the multidimensional facets of champaca entwine with the velvety ease of Iso E Super, leaving a luxuriously luminous trail that lingers with quiet elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Voyage d'Hermès, Eau de Toilette Refillable, 100ml
listings.description: Fresh woody notes are lively and reassuring; the brightness of juniper berries contrasts with the energy of cedar and the softness of white musks. "An invitation to discover, meet and share." Jean-Claude Ellena. A novel that feeds on the imagination, Voyage d’Hermès expresses the long-standing and unusual relationship between the house and travel. An interplay of paradoxes, complements and unexpected alliances supports the premise of woody notes that are fresh yet musky, familiar yet surprising, hovering between impulsive and comforting, equally at ease with men as with women. Hermès designer Philippe Mouquet created a travel object bottle for Voyage d’Hermès, designed for journeys and symbolic of movement.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Rosa Verde Eau de Toilette Refill, 200ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover the Rosa Verde refill, the easy way to refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step. Rosa Verde, a vibrant rose bathed in freshness, that captures the feel-good effect of a dive on a summer’s day. The exhilarating aquatic freshness of cucumber evokes the invigorating frisson of skin plunging into water. The caress of rose soon unfolds, like the wave of pleasure that floods the body under the water’s surface. A vibrant green floral duo, accented with a crisp pear note and mellowed by a white musk accord. For the first time, Guerlain is exploring the emotions aroused by the fragrances in its iconic collection through the prism of the Science of the Emotions, which studies the close links between scents and emotions. At the heart of this approach, the Rosa Verde perfume offers an instant feeling of pleasure and relaxation¹. "Rosa Verde is the memory of an invigorating and relaxing dive. A rose bathed in freshness that unfurls on skin like a wave of well-being." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfume Creation Director & Perfumer. A real symbol of Guerlain’s commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria fragrances are composed of more than 90% naturally derived ingredients². The French beetroot alcohol contained in their formulas is sourced from suppliers committed to sustainable agriculture. The 200ml refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. ¹Using the Rosa Verde perfume increases the feeling of pleasure (self-assessment on 37 subjects) and the feeling of relaxation (instrumental test on 34 subjects). ²Calculation based on the international ISO 16128 standard, including water. ³Only on 75mL and 125mL sales formats. How to use: 1. Unscrew the spray pump 2. To start refilling, turn your refill upside down and screw onto your bottle 3. Refilling stops automatically once your bottle is full. Next, unscrew the refill and replace with the spray pump

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Calèche Soie de Parfum Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Created by perfumer Guy Robert in 1961, Hermès’ first fragrance for women, Calèche, was reinterpreted in 1992 as Calèche Soie de Parfum, the name of which refers to the horse-drawn carriages that are emblematic of the house and its silk métier. Floral with aldehyde aromas, Calèche Soie de Parfum combines the refined notes of aldehyde with opulent jasmine and generous rose. The bottle, inspired by the lanterns of horse-drawn carriages, has a black cap reminiscent of a riding hat. The back label is illustrated with a design by Philippe Dumas, indicating that it belongs to the Parfums-Fondateurs collection. The Parfums-Fondateurs Collection: The Parfums-Fondateurs collection draws inspiration from the house’s heritage. Each creation encapsulates Hermès’ imaginary world in a name, a fragrance and a colour. Over the years, Hermès has pioneered a bold style of perfumery, resulting from encounters with exceptional perfumers. Written in 1961 by Guy Robert, Calèche was Hermès' first fragrance for women. A highly feminine, woody, chypre floral, its name refers to the horse-drawn carriages that are emblematic of the house. Calèche is a novel that dazzles with the beauty of its raw materials, from the joyfulness of citrus fruit to the modernity of aldehyde notes; from the floral heart embellished with ylang-ylang, rose and jasmine to the woody, chypre sillage underscored by the nobility of the iris.

As an undeniable enigma, he lives by the essence of self-confidence and forges his own elusive path. Revealed to the world at nighttime in Paris, the bewitching city of lights, he is boldly non–conformist yet vulnerable, leaving an enchanting aura in his wake. Powered by the most mysterious facet of you, Phantom Eau de Toilette is unapologetically bold, yet sophisticated, combining a hypnotic blend of creamy lavender, energising lemon and addictive vanilla. Blended to perfection with the utmost refinement, Phantom Eau de Toilette by Rabanne is responsibly formulated with the most precious, ethically–sourced ingredients. listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Vétiver Eau de Toilette Intense 50ml
listings.description: Issey Miyake’s Eau de toilette intense, l’Eau d’Issey pour Homme. Discover L’Eau d’Issey pour Homme Vétiver, the new vegan-certified Issey Miyake men’s eau de toilette intense. Water, calm, the purist expression of what is essential, meets matter, dense, textured, evolving. The impulse created by the union of the elements gives birth to l’Eau d’Issey pour Homme Vétiver. Fragrance: The woody notes of vetiver, lifted by spicy ginger and warm sage. A streamlined formula composed only of essentials, like an ode to the elements, triggers an instant addiction. The vetiver comes from Haiti and is 100% of natural origin. It is ethically grown and harvested by local farmers. In this new Eau de toilette Intense, vetiver root exudes its woody generosity. Design: With L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme Vétiver, Issey Miyake offers a new take on the brand’s iconic perfume bottle by infusing it with a brown tone reminiscent of vetiver root. The refined glass perfume bottle contrasts with the brown ash cap, symbolising the encounter between the absolute purity of water and the sensory and authentic nature of wood. Committed to nature: The bottle for the Eau de toilette Intense L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme Vétiver is made from 20% PCR glass and its cap is plastic-free and made entirely from natural wood. The fragrance is vegan and composed of 93% ingredients of natural origin. Top notes: Ginger Heart notes: Clary Sage Base notes: Vetiver How to use: Spray the fragrance directly onto pulse points (neck, wrists, inner elbows).

The silver and gold atomiser spray, with its industrial edge, complements the bottle’s elemental design and the clean curves of the glass. Within the bottle, the hue of the Absolu de Parfum is intensified, offering a visual hint at the rich concentration of fragrance inside. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Caban Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent's pea coat – caban in French – is known for its fascinating sophistication and its role in defining the maison's signature style. The fragrance mirrors the coat's comforting warmth and sleek lines with tonka bean, which brings notes of almond, caramel, and tobacco to the forefront. The olfaction: Inspired by YSL’s sleek, empowering pea coat, Caban reveals the innate elegance and sophistication of a simple olfactory shape, built around warm, lush tonka bean absolute. Run through with boldly woody tones, this fascinating tonka is textured with bright spices. Airy, fresh, and electric with a fruity facet, pink pepper absolute reflects light like carved golden buttons on a couture YSL caban. Tactile and sleekly sophisticated, Caban embodies a modern look with a raw yet enveloping impact. Fragrance family: Woody Spicy. Top notes: Pink Pepper Oil, Black Pepper Oil, Elemi Oil Heart notes: Olibanum Resinoid, Osmanthus Base notes: Sandalwood Oil, Tonka Bean, Patchouli Heart The inspiration: It was the very first piece Yves Saint Laurent presented under his name, in 1962. Opening his fashion show, worn with white shantung pants and mules, the thick wool double-breasted overcoat worn by sailors to ward off the cold and the rain - the caban, or pea coat – was reinvented as a couture garment. And paved the way for Yves Saint Laurent’s signature style, which borrowed from menswear to make women feel comfortable and confident. Turning the simplicity of a practical garment into the ultimate form of refinement, YSL’s caban has shown its range throughout the years, asserting a marine-inspired look or nonchalantly worn over a sleek cream satin gown. The Caban is more than just a single garment; it's a symbol of the YSL style, its clean lines and structured shape contributed to the distinctive YSL silhouette. blending masculine tailoring with feminine grace, female empowerment, and timeless sophistication. The Caban conveys a sense of confidence and power. When a person wears a Caban, they adopt a garment that historically signified authority and strength. This creates a sense of self-assuredness and boldness without compromising its fascinating elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre L'Eau Nue Parfum de Peau 50ml
listings.description: Summer freedom in a scent for radiant skin. Libre L'Eau Nue is the first alcohol-free Parfum de Peau by Yves Saint Laurent. A sun-kissed, radiant and sultry scent of long Mediterranean summers on your skin. A unique sensorial experience that enhances the skin with a radiant glow.​ The bottle: Discover the iconic bottle of Libre in a new radical white couture piece. A shiny white finish that mirrors the sunlight and enhances the sparkling gold Cassandre. The slanted black cap adds a couture asymmetry to this sculptural bottle. A new it-bottle echoing the uniqueness of Libre L'Eau Nue. How to use: A new sensorial fragrance gesture to suit your mood. Smell it. Feel it. Experience the sensorial pleasure of Libre L'Eau Nue on your pulse points and skin. Sensually envelop your body for a lasting fragrance. Add a mist to your hair for a feel-good finishing touch. Control the intensity: a 30cm (12") spray creates a light, airy mist. For a more concentrated, sensual experience, spray closer and massage into the skin. Mist hair from 15cm (6") and lightly run your fingers through your lengths to evenly spread the product. Do not intentionally be exposed to the sun. Do not use it on the face. Avoid spraying towards the eyes. In case of contact, rinse immediately and thoroughly.

listings.rawTitle: TOCCA Lucia Eau de Parfum Travel Spray
listings.description: Lucia Eau de Parfum is TOCCA’s luminous fresh floral fragrance, light enough for daily wear. Lucia captures the essence of dolce far niente, the cherished Italian art of slowing down and savouring life’s simple pleasures. Sunlit lemon and woody vetiver slow-dance in quiet reverie with lush fig from the garden. Fragrance family: Fresh Floral. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Lemon Oil Italy Orpur, Grapefruit, Mandarin, Marine Accord Heart notes: Fig, Fig Tree Leaves, Upcycled Rose Water, Geranium Oil Egypt Orpur Base notes: Vetiver Oil Haiti Orpur, Cedarwood, Tobacco, Fig Tree Wood TOCCA fragrances are inspired by powerful feminine archetypes, both mythic and modern muses. Crafted by master perfumers with the world’s finest ingredients, each Eau de Parfum is housed in a fluted Italian glass bottle with a hand-finished cap — a graceful tribute to feminine beauty and confidence. How to use: Spray generously onto your wrists, neck, and pulse points.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Rose Magnetic by Sophie Labbé Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Rose Magnetic sublimates the most sensual of flowers, the rose. All its facets are expressed in turn, with playfulness, addiction and modernity, thanks to the combination of the natural Rose Essential™ LMR and the natural Turkish Rose Absolute LMR, both certified 'For Life', produced with respect for the environment and helping the local communities get better and more stable revenues. The bitterness of grapefruit and the freshness of peppermint invite the sweet femininity of the queen of flowers to bloom freely. Its character becomes magnetic with the attraction of lychee, vibrating cedar natural woods, musks and natural vanilla bean.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Holiday Gift Set
listings.description: Celebrate the joy of giving with this Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum holiday gift set for women. This refined ambery floral fragrance features pink pepper, mandora, and bergamot top notes; lilac, violet, rose, and geranium heart notes; and amber and patchouli base notes. This gift set contains: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women, 90ml (3.0oz) Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Perfumed Body Lotion for Women, 50ml (1.6oz)

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Rouge Hermès Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: A fragrance coloured by passion where the sensuality of vanilla mingles with rose and ylang-ylang.Sophisticated and unsettling, the most oriental of the Hermès fragrances. When it was created by Akiko Kamei, this fragrance bore the name Parfum d’Hermès. Reinterpreted and renamed Rouge Hermès at the turn of the third millennium, this semi-oriental, ambery floral reflects the emblematic colour of the house and is the very essence of sophistication. Its sillage is unforgettable as much by its richness as by its masterful style. A novel of love, a vividly poetic writing style, an oriental feel, expressing an assertive and sensual femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Addictive and irresistible, Daisy Love fills the air with a contagious love of life. Created by master perfumer Alberto Morillas, this gourmand radiant perfume for women reveals its first notes in a vibrant burst of sweet cloudberries. Delicate daisy tree petals mingle with sparkling cashmere musks and driftwood to create a lasting and memorable gourmand twist. An ode to the Marc Jacobs iconic daisy, Daisy Love blooms with an over-sized daisy that reflects over the warm glow of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Flora Luminare Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Transport the senses to languid mornings on an idyllic island with this fragrance. Solar notes of bitter almond soften into neroli and tiare absolute, culminating in a creamy trail of sandalwood and musk. The fragrance: Top notes of bitter almond, mandarin, petitgrain and olibanum A heart of neroli, tiare absolute, jasmine absolute and rose absolute A base of mate absolute, sandalwood, cedarwood and musk Olfactive Signature: Ylang-ylang. Fragrance family: Floral. Explore: London via Tahiti. Sheer turquoise lagoons gleam translucent with slivers of morning light. Coral gardens illuminated with incandescent clarity. Bountiful heads of pure white tiare and jasmine mingle with precious, golden ylang-ylang, trade winds waft their heady aroma to Pointe Vénus. Escape to an otherworldly atoll idyll. Utopian. Luminous. Solar.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Polka Paradise Eau de Parfum, 80ml
listings.description: A summer-ready collector’s edition of Good Girl Blush. Good Girl Blush turns pink into power. Bright, bold and ultra-feminine, she embodies a new kind of allure, flirty, sassy and strong. Vibrant and full of energy, she’s the Good Girl who glows with confidence. It’s so good to be bad.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Blanche Absolu de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Blanche Absolu reimagines the iconic scent with a heightened contrast between purity and warmth, paying tribute to Blanche’s story of intimacy, texture, and comfort. It further intensifies and reveals the sensuality of skin and touch, wrapping the body in lingering warmth. The crisp aldehydic notes are blended with black pepper and warm neroli, giving way to a more vivid floral heart. Rose, violet, and jasmine unfold with a stronger, subtly fruity nuance. The fragrance is anchored by sensual white musk, indulgent cashmere wood, and inviting ambroxan. The Absolu de Parfum is held in a redesigned bottle, an homage to craftsmanship. Embodying the deep intensity and transformation, the textured cap, inspired by Yakisugi, the Japanese art of charring wood, opens to reveal the silver and gold atomiser spray, complementing the bottle’s elemental design and the clean curves of the glass that show the intense colour of the fragrance within. Floral Genderless Notes: Top: Aldehyde, Black Pepper, Neroli Heart: Rose Absolute, Violet, Jasmine Base: Ambroxan, Cashmere Woods, White Musk How to use: To be sprayed on the skin and/or clothes.

listings.description: Velvety Rose is enveloped in elegant White Patchouli to create the new addictive floral perfume for women, Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Rose Velvet. A captivating fragrance in which tenderness is the new bold. Infused with top notes of succulent Blackcurrant, this graceful feminine fragrance reveals a heart of velvety Rose, Irresistible’s signature note. This new floral facet is embraced by the powdery softness of Iris, fusing with the warmth of Tender Wood and sensual White Patchouli. Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Rose Velvet is an irresistible fragrance that invites you to embrace your tender side.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A timeless icon evolves in 2026. Reimagined with a deeper, more enduring intensity, this classic Eau de Parfum preserves the unmistakable signature of The One, now with enhanced longevity. Crafted for the refined man with an elegant, distinctive character, the fragrance reveals a new olfactory depth. The reworked base with the addition of tobacco amplifies warmth and sensuality, and is designed to last up to 16 hours. The fragrance was created by Jean-Christophe Hérault exclusively for Dolce & Gabbana. Fragrance notes: Top notes: The opening is bright and refined: Tarocco Orange releases its natural sweetness, while the sparkling freshness of Grapefruit brings vitality to the composition Heart notes: At the heart, French Clary Sage adds aromatic elegance and depth Base notes: In the base, the fragrance reveals its full intensity: the addition of an enveloping accord of Tobacco, enhanced by the original amber and woody nuances, leaves a warm, sensual, and long-lasting trail

Set contains: CK One Eau de Toilette, 50ml CK One Shower Gel, 100ml

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Oud For Grace Eau De Parfum, 90ml
listings.description: OUD FOR GRACE from INITIO Parfums Privés reinterprets Oud through a refined, contemporary lens. This Eau de Parfum spray opens with luminous Bergamot and Black Pepper, revealing precious woods and Oud, softened by warm Vanilla and Praline.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Moonlight In Heaven Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy’s Inspiration: A dazzling beam of pearlized light dances on the oceans belly, witnessed by two lovers who watch from a balcony draped in floating white opaque gauze that seems alive, responding to a warm wind that blows. The lovers, high above the world to almost touch the stars, with full hearts and bodies light as air. The Perfume: A true olfactory pleasure, the fresh perfume of tasty mango and the fresh scent of powdered sambac jasmine are mixed with coconut milk and rice, of a pallor similar to the moon, all wrapped in tonka bean and the delicacy of vetiver. Both unique and familiar, this fresh perfume with an exotic fragrance from Moonlight in Heaven pushes you to open the doors of paradise. Perfume notes: Grapefruit, Mango, Roasted Tonka Beans. Perfumer: Calice Becker.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Fantasies Ideal One Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Ideal One tells the fantasy of the magnetic intimacy between you and a dream partner, who has been conceived to be the perfect match, captured in a carnal and sensual skin scent. Each of the Replica Fantasies fragrances is shaped around a surreal ingredient, born from the imagination of Perfumers. Master Perfumer Christophe Raynaud has bottled this fantasy, crafting this new fragrance around a unique Skin Fusion Accord. Imagine feeling your essences intertwining in a singular, skin-to-skin, intoxicating moment. So intense that the boundaries between you and your ideal one begin to blur, to become one. With this powerful trail, dream of carrying the permanent imprint of your Ideal One close to your skin.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Muse Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: To draw the silhouette of his ideal, trace the iconic pieces his muses inspired, the couturier dipped his pen in the darkest of inks. Thousands of sketches embody the essence of the couturier’s aesthetics in fluid black lines. The ink blends all of his unforgettable muses, as captured through Yves Saint Laurent’s vision. The olfaction: To capture the essence of his muses, Yves Saint Laurent turned to ink. Thousands of sketches flowed from his hand, each fluid stroke revealing the inspiring silhouettes of his ideal. In those bold, black lines, he translated inspiration into tangible form, immortalising the essence of his muses and all the creativity he drew from them. Ink is the enigmatic accord chosen for Le Vestiaire des Parfums’s new fragrance: Muse. A strikingly streamlined composition crafted by Principal Perfumer Marie Salamagne: "The ink reveals enigmatic woody notes, intimate and elegant smoky facets. It veils the skin in subtle, dark, metallic tones, slightly iris-y, earthy. For me, the ink takes on the colours of creativity and mystery. It stimulates the imagination." The dusky note is etched onto a precious ingredient, Marie Salamagne compares both to paper and skin, for its softness. Carnal and supple, iris concrete offers powdery, buttery, woody and leather facets for a perfect blend. Empowered by a sensual Bourbon vanilla absolute pod – another sublime material crafted for YSL - the result is what Marie Salamagne calls "a skin scent that explodes." A fragrant tattoo with an impressive trail, as distinctive and memorable as YSL’s fascinating muses. Fragrance family: Woody Ambery. Top notes: Incense, Lavender Ourika, Clary Sage Heart Heart notes: Ink accord, Ambrette Absolute Base notes: Vanilla Bourbon Absolute, Iris Concrete and Ambery Woods Accord The inspiration: Elegant. Empowered. Androgynous. Yves Saint Laurent’s muses were like no other. Inspiring silhouettes – artists, models, actors, friends and loved ones, starting with his mother – who embodied the couturier’s style, spirit and ideal. At the heart of every Yves Saint Laurent creation lies the inspiration he drew from his muses. Their unique energy ignited Mr. Saint Laurent’s imagination and shaped his designs. More than just inspirations, they were the living embodiment of his vision. A vision that liberated the silhouette, redefined beauty, and ultimately, transformed an era. His muses were the epitome of the YSL style. They exuded a nonchalant elegance, a sense of effortless sophistication. They were often seen in simple yet impeccably tailored pieces, effortlessly donning tuxedos, embodying a chic silhouette. They were also the embodiment of the YSL spirit. They moved through the world with a captivating blend of purpose and individuality. They exuded an effortless confidence that defied convention by embracing androgyny, bold style choices.

His muses were the epitome of the YSL style. They exuded a nonchalant elegance, a sense of effortless sophistication. They were often seen in simple yet impeccably tailored pieces, effortlessly donning tuxedos, embodying a chic silhouette. They were also the embodiment of the YSL spirit. They moved through the world with a captivating blend of purpose and individuality. They exuded an effortless confidence that defied convention by embracing androgyny, bold style choices.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Fantasies Celestial Whispers Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: A talismanic fragrance capturing the feeling of being surrounded by a protective, ethereal embrace. A chance to step outside of the pressures of everyday life, and to take a moment to pause and reflect. Celestial Whispers captures this contemplative mood in a powerfully smoky, fresh, and spicy olfactive trail. Each of the Replica Fantasies fragrances is structured around a surreal ingredient which stems from the imagination of Master Perfumers. At the heart of this new Eau de Parfum, Master Perfumer Daniela Andrier shaped a surreal fragrance accord, the Celestial Smoke. This imaginary treasure captures the fantasy sensation of being enveloped by delicate, fragrant swirls of bright white smoke as they rise in the air, sheltering you in a halo of positive energy. Celestial Whispers cloaks you in an aura of fragrant protection, as the warmth of incense smoke intertwines with the metallic brightness of aldhehydes. The fantasy of a fragrance imbued with protective virtues.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Nuit d'Oranger Eau de Parfum for Women 50ml
listings.description: In the Chloé Atelier des Fleurs collection, artist perfumers guide your eyes and your nose towards singular flowers. Capturing Nature’s hidden scents and revealing the beauty in the unexplored through women's fragrance. The Fleurs de Nuit women's Eau de Parfum collection unveils the unsuspected fragrance of three flowers whose perfume changes as night falls. During the day, these enigmatic flowers absorb the brightness and warmth of the sun. At dusk - only at dusk - they fully blossom and release new carnal, narcotic notes to create a sophisticated scent. Among this women's perfume collection is Nuit d'Oranger Eau de Parfum for Women. A symbol of the Mediterranean basin where the founder of Chloé, Gaby Aghion, was born, Orange Blossom has a fresh, delicate smell during the day. At night, it releases a generous, sensual scent that grows in intensity until dawn. In this fragrance composed by Alex Lee, Orange Blossom appears in two different forms: an airy Neroli gradually gives way to an opulent, honeyed Orange Blossom absolute. In the background of this fragrance for women, Mate and Patchouli form a herbaceous accord evoking the nature that surrounds the orange blossom. For the Fleurs de Nuit collection, the iconic Atelier des Fleurs bottle takes on a captivating shade of midnight blue – a deep mysterious colour inspired by the vastness of the celestial vault – and features an undulating glass silhouette, evoking the sunburst pleating so dear to the Maison, and a sand-colored cap. A floral scent from Chloé that is a concentrate of timeless elegance. Fragrance family: Floral. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance that stays all day, delicately spray this floral perfume on clothing and pulse points at the neck, chest and wrists.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Herba Mimosa Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Herba Mimosa, a luminous perfume for women by Amandine Clerc-Marie. This tender, powdery women's Eau de Parfum echoes a memory from Amandine Clerc-Marie's youth: the stirred emotions of discovering mimosas blooming in the hills of Grasse when she was 20. The powdery, woody and luminous facets of mimosa blossoms lend a botanical facet to the composition of this spring fragrance. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Herba Mimosa with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

The gourmand signature of the original Eau de Parfum is wrapped in luminous plum blossom notes. Sparkling mandarin, creamy sandalwood and comforting musk notes convey warmth and depth. listings.description: JUles Verne. He was born in Nantes, at the beginning of that century of discoveries. The close ocean took him far away, inspiring in him extraordinary novels of adventure. Inspired by the father of literary science fiction, this Eau de Parfum breathes its aromatic Hesperides-like scents, just as a marine breeze over a wild heath. The scent of a treasure chest crafted from precious Wood and filled with spices from faraway lands, stowed on a boat sailing uncharted seas. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Grapefruit, Citrus, Tangerine, Eucalyptus Heart notes: Nutmeg, Pepper Base notes: Cedar, Incense, Vetiver, Pinecone

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her
listings.description: The fragrance: Feel the power of attraction pull you in with BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her, an intense, addictive scent that captures the strong, undeniable chemistry flowing between a power couple. The scent: A rich, full-bodied interpretation of the iconic signature BOSS The Scent, this ambery-floral-woody fragrance unites intense contrasts to unleash an alchemy of attraction. It opens with an overdose of addictive Orange Blossom, played against the enveloping warmth of Vetiver. The heated tension is further heightened by mysterious, airy Akigalawood, weaving through the base in a mesmerising embrace that entices the senses. The bottle: BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her reinvents empowering sensuality in a striking flacon featuring the BOSS logo on deep-plum lacquered glass and a Double-B monogrammed rose-gold cap. Capturing the spotlight, its multi-faceted shape reflects the sensorial showdown within this powerfully evocative scent, while echoing the many sides of a power couple. How to use: Spray BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her on pulse points around the body to increase the longevity of this addictive scent for women.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Absolue Les Parfums Not Your Rose Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: In this land where nature's grandeur lives untamed, we grow a rose like no other. Absolue Les Parfums, a radical collection dedicated to our rose, born in our domain. Our first-ever rose-dedicated haute-parfumerie collection composed of 11 scents unveils our exclusive centifolia rose like you've never smelled before. Reinventing perfumery's iconic ingredient. Not Your Rose Eau de Parfum with Ambrette and moss. Hiding in the winter haze, she is not your rose. Cold and mysterious, she cannot be possessed. Almost impossible to reach, she belongs to nature. Surviving the winter frost, she is glistening with aquatic rose and enveloped in soft musk. Meet The Perfumer. Caroline Dumur: "Hiding in the winter haze, the rose is at the same time fresh, almost cold and sensual, shaded with mystery. [...] an enigmatic accord that takes us back to that ephemeral moment, just after the rain... highlighted with ambrette, gently iridescent." How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Hypnotic Poison Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Seeped in extreme natural tones, Hypnotic Poison Eau de Parfum draws its strength from powerful absolutes. The lush charm of sambac jasmine absolute mingled with a welcoming orange blossom absolute is wrapped in smooth, intensely evocative tonka bean. The round licorice note behind the seductiveness of Hypnotic Poison is boosted to new, bolder heights. It creates irresistible appeal empowered by the vanilla, an immediate sign of gratitude. An atmosphere of total deliciousness reigns supreme. The bottle of Hypnotic Poison-fragrance of mystery-is an absolute icon. A sultry incarnation of the forbidden fruit.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 01 Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Escentric 01 celebrates the hyper-abstraction of Iso E Super. Escentric 01 focuses on Iso E Super at 65% of the fragrance compound in an abbreviated formula designed to maximise the molecule's efflorescence. It contains lime peel, hedione (green jasmine bud), orris incense, balsamic notes, and fresh musk, producing a seriously lingering base note. Iso E Super does not exist in nature and was created in a laboratory at the IFF in 1973. This composition echoes the mystical power of Escentric 01 in a cult-scented formula that will add a dose of olfactory intrigue to your everyday. A unisex fragrance liberated from preconceptions of identity and form. We heard the best things come in small packages. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden A Gloaming Night Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci fragrances opens a new story of magic and imagination in Luxury Collection: The Alchemist’s Garden. The singular unisex fragrances in The Alchemist's collection of Eau de Parfum, Acqua Profumata and Perfumed Oils become customisable and transformative when layered in a multitude of perfume combinations to construct a special enticing scent that stays with you all day - the amount the perfume lingers in the air when it is worn. “The Perfumed Oils and Acqua Profumata create mesmerising individual statements. Each oil or floral water of the collection can be layered with each Eau de Parfum. Just play with the scent to find your favourite, as an alchemist would work to find the gold formula,” says Alberto Morillas. The scent: A Gloaming Night continues the story of magic and imagination created by Maître Parfumeur Alberto Morillas with a Gucci perfume built around an aromatic combination. The irresistible scent, bewitching like no other, opens with the warmth of Cinnamon, reveals a deep woody Vetiver and falls into the Patchouli intensity. The bottle: The design of each Eau de Parfum bottle is inspired by the bottles found on wooden shelves of a vintage apothecary, curious pharmacy jars and the first perfumery containers. Gold lettering, decoration and secret symbols appear on the Eau de Parfum, contained in lacquered Gucci fragrance glass bottles with stoppers - covetable objects for lovers of mystery. How to use: Each Perfumed Oil and Acqua Profumata in The Alchemist's collection can be layered with each Eau de Parfum: experiment with combinations to build a unique scent of your beloved scent. Bottling the essence of nature into sublime distillations, the customisable compositions are designed to be layered together, each building from a hero ingredient that shifts and magnifies its character when paired with other Gucci fragrances. The beauty of alchemy is in the transformation: layered scents that become new expressions of art and unfold the magic of unseen worlds. Layer pure and highly concentrated perfumed oils with the Eaux de Parfum to intensify its strength and richness: Apply your choice of The Alchemist Perfumed Oil first on the wrist and neck Follow with your Eau de Parfum layered on top The Acqua Profumata can be applied over the Eau de Parfum to recharge top notes and refresh the overall impression of your signature scent A recommended layer combination for A Gloaming Night perfume, designed to bring out the different facets of its enticing woody spicy scent: Like sunset falling around you, deepen A Gloaming Night Gucci perfume with Nocturnal Whisper perfumed oil. The pair brings out a spicy oud, elegant and exquisite Add texture with delicate Fading Autumn perfumed water for a captivating, intense wood finish

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Florabloom Eau de Toilette
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Florabloom, a joyful, multicoloured explosion of rainbow florals within a bouquet whose heart radiates with true-to-nature tuberose. Set around dazzling white tuberose flower, roses, iris and violets accords come together against a mossy background to reveal sunny and bright creamy facets. Inspired by a rare natural phenomenon known as a superbloom, this creation evokes the multicoloured carpets of desert flowers that so spectacularly spring to life after heavy rainfall. "Florabloom is a celebration of the power and beauty of nature, that’s both wild and poetic." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria fragrances contain up to 95% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The Aqua Allegoria fragrances are housed in a screw-top, refillable bottle made in France from at least 15% recycled glass. The 200 mL refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75 mL and 125 mL bottles. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with ISO 16128, calculation including water. How to use: Create your own signature fragrance by combining Florabloom with either Flora Salvaggia, Nettare di Sole, Pera Granita or Flora Cherrysia. For the ideal amount of fragrance, simply choose your preferred pairing from the collection and spray in equal quantities.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau & Magnolia Eau de Toilette Intense
listings.description: While the heart of the fragrance boasts a floral bouquet bursting with water, notes of magnolia are enhanced by an aquatic freshness. A precious wood base brings the olfactory trail to its conclusion. The inspiration: It all started with water, source of life, original element, raw material, source of endless possibilities. A drop gave rise to the first Issey Miyake fragrance, which continues its journey now to encounter the aerial and delicately feminine magnolia flower. A new encounter between pure water and sensory nature. The bottle: Issey Miyake wanted to present L'Eau d'Issey in a bottle that could transcend the boundaries of time and fashion, and L’Eau d’Issey Eau & Magnolia pays tribute to this bottle in its own unique way. A minimalist bottle that gets back to the essential, adorned with a touch of beige and topped with a wooden cap echoing the raw, untouched nature that has inspired it. The bottle of L’Eau d’Issey Eau & Magnolia is made of 20% recycled PCR glass. Each wooden cap, made of ash, is unique in terms of its colour and its veins. The fragrance itself is vegan and made of 85% of natural origin ingredients.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Miss Dior Essence de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: A symbol of confident, liberated femininity imagined by Francis Kurkdjian, Dior Perfume Creative Director, the new Miss Dior Essence expresses its intensity in a high concentration through a trail saturated by colours, with gourmand and sensual accords. Miss Dior Essence will surprise and draw you in at the same time: the succulent blackberry and elderflower accord transcends a wildly luxurious jasmine bouquet. On a base of dense, enveloping woody oak accords, this mischievous chypre resonates like a bold brushstroke on Miss Dior's floral olfactory canvas. The new Miss Dior Essence becomes the manifesto of a new generation of women freed from social conventions. Miss Dior Essence asserts itself while staying true to its original identity, reinterpreting the heritage bottle designed by Christian Dior in 1948: a frosted houndstooth motif and a black grosgrain 'poignard' bow made in France, which adorns a precious glass cap.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez NARCISO Poudrée Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: With his line ‘NARCISO’, Narciso Rodriguez creates a set of perfumes that plays with the extremes of seduction and attraction. Enter NARCISO Eau de Parfum Poudrée: a feminine fragrance that channels its wearer’s beauty from within, building on this mystery of attraction. The Fragrance: Powerfully feminine, NARCISO Eau de Parfum Poudrée enwraps the body in an intensity that’s sweet and unique. The patented heart of musc, found only in Narciso Rodriguez fragrances, is combined with white jasmine at the top and woody vetiver at the base. This powdery fragrance, as the name suggests, is only strengthened with the addition of black cedar and vetiver. The Bottle: An original bottle, the lacquered glass cube matches its cap to the bottle, the lacquer contouring towards the base in a semi-oval shape. It sits beautifully on its own as well as alongside other fragrances from the NARCISO line. Top notes: White jasmine petals and Bulgarian rose Middle notes: A powdery heart of musk Base notes: White and black cedars, vetiver

listings.description: Cheeky Biquíni Perfume Mist is inspired by the playful freedom of Praia do Abricó, Rio’s legendary nude beach. Ripe and sun-kissed, this fragrance bursts open with mouthwatering apricot nectar, then entices with fresh orange blossom and sheer vanilla. Bare it all.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Intense 75ml
listings.description: L’Eau d’Issey pour Homme offers the right balance of strength sparkling notes. A freshness that lasts and surprises with an unexpected burst of tangerine and yuzu, Japanese lemon accord with a deep and vibrant aroma like a memory. At the heart, the Water Lily note gives an aquatic facet of L’Eau d’Issey pour Homme, subtly warmed by spicy notes. The base notes provide a marked masculine presence, with the assertive character of sandalwood, vetiver and tobacco amber accord. How to use: Warmth intensifies fragrance. Apply it to your body’s warmest points, such as the creases of your elbows and wrists for more strength and longevity. Avoid rubbing or dabbing after application, as this can break down the fragrance. For wrist application, apply the fragrance after hand washing which can rinse off the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Héritage Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Created in 1992 by Jean-Paul Guerlain, Héritage celebrates the transmission of values from one generation to the next. With its secretive, discreet and refined scent, it illustrates nuanced masculinity. Inspired by yesterday's generations, Héritage is a fragrance dedicated to the men of tomorrow. It opens with aromatic freshness, succeeded by the subtlety of a warm spicy accord on a woody dry-down with shades of the East. Héritage, for a man who is at once a trustee for tradition and a herald of a new spirit. Spicy Ambery. Refined, warm, authentic. The exuberant freshness of lemon and bergamot top notes meets an aromatic breeze of lavender. Then, the heart is enriched with fresh, spicy notes such as coriander and pink pepper. Finally, with the patchouli there emerges a rich, ambery woody dry-down.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irrésistible Eau de Parfum, 80ml
listings.description: Discover the iconic floral trail of Very Irrésistible Eau de Parfum by Givenchy in a new ultra-feminine redesigned bottle. The iconic floral fragrance: Composed of five roses of exceptional quality, aromatic Star Anis offers a vibrant contrast at the heart of Very Irrésistible Eau de Parfum, amplified by Patchouli wood and Vanilla. A sensual and feminine signature for those who embrace their individuality. A redesigned couture bottle: The prismatic lines of this restyled bottle exudes sophistication, beautifully contrasted by the freshness of its violet-coloured lacquer. Inspired by timeless elegance: Radiantly feminine, this floral fragrance is the promise of timeless elegance with a hint of fantasy. A unique contrast, enhanced by the trail of a captivating muse no one can resist.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Narciso Rodriguez celebrates spring through the striking beauty of flowers. This year, love blossoms as an ode to the art of the bloom. An addictive chypre ambery fragrance: Discover For Her Eau de Parfum Intense, the vegan perfume for women by Narciso Rodriguez. A story of introspection for the confident woman who expresses her innermost self with a striking intensity. This powerful new perfume takes the iconic for her sillage to intense new heights in a chypre ambery fragrance. Top notes of fruity peach are invigorated by the citrus spark of bergamot. At the core, the For Her heart of musc signature is enriched with a burst of a solar white flowers accord, creating a hypnotic bouquet. At the base, sensual vanilla and vetiver diffuse an ambery woody trail of exquisite depth. A 100% cardboard giftset, more responsibly crafted. Less is more: Giftset 100% cardboard. Narciso Rodriguez has designed its gift boxes in a more responsible way. We encourage you to give your gift boxes a second life by reusing or recycling them*. *Recycling guidelines may vary by location. listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Musk Therapy Body Cream
listings.description: This cream carries the restorative power of Musk Therapy. Emotions align and sensation flow, sit melts into the skin, amplifying sensation and bringing you to a heightened state of emotional freedom. Notes: bergamot, mandarin, white magnolia, cassis, white sandalwood, white musk, rose musk.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Vra Vra Vroom Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Dash it all and make haste! An energetic blast of mandarin and magnolia, enthusiastic spoonfuls of osmanthus absolute. Spritz your way to success. Nothing shall stop one now. All purchases will include a sample of the same scent to test before opening up the full-size fragrance. You lucky thing! Key notes: apricot, leather, osmanthus. "An invigorating infusion of magnolia and sage to unlock one’s imagination. Leathery floral notes revitalise and refresh."

listings.description: The coast of Madagascar, rich with orchid-filled jungle and green fields of tall grass.
