listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Favorite Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier has met his match. A woman who dares. A woman who defies. Gaultier's spirit incarnate: La Favorite. This floral amber Eau de Parfum mesmerises with its audacious aroma, where smouldering benzoin blends with the radiant allure of Queen of the Night. Addiction? Inevitable. For her, Gaultier has crafted a revolutionary bottle, its playful silhouette a wink to the iconic Fragile. She’s who we aspire to be, adored by all; she becomes our role model, our inspiring idol, our favourite. Her mantra? "Own the Light!" A rallying cry of self-assurance. An invitation to embrace audacity. Paris is her playground. The Eiffel Tower, her stage. The interior small figurine comes in the 50ml & 100ml formats. Fragrance description: A Floral amber of unparalleled audacity, quintessentially Gaultier. This Jean Paul Gaultier Eau de Parfum unveils an intense, addictive floral amber accord. At the heart of the scent lies an extraordinary benzoin duo, releasing rich, liqueur-like vanilla notes. Complementing this, Queen of the Night glows with a captivating brilliance. The base notes reveal tonka bean, cloaking the fragrance in a lingering sensuality. La Favorite never plays it safe. Neither does her fragrance. Your La Favorite bottle can be refilled in four steps, each executed with panache: 1. Unscrew the pump of your bottle with confidence, without hesitation 2. Screw the La Favorite refill onto your bottle and turn until you feel resistance: the filling begins automatically. The bottle fills. The intensity returns 3. When the bottle is full, refilling will stop automatically. Unscrew the refill tip 4. Screw the pump back on tightly. Your bottle regains its radiance. You're ready to take the stage again. Time and time again

listings.description: Eau de Citron Noir expresses the joyful and generous freshness of the Colognes in the form of a hand and body cleansing gel. Another way to wear fragrance. Eau de Citron Noir combines the sharp and zesty freshness of lemon with the depth of black tea and the smoky notes of guaiac wood. The straight lines of the bottle are embellished with a radical deep blue, emblematic of Eau de Citron Noir, and two signature details: the H imprint of the base and the saddle nail engraved on the pump. The bottle is made of recyclable glass. The Eau de Citron Noir hair and body shower gel refill can be used to replenish the 300ml bottle. A responsible gesture, integral to an object created to last. A rich gel that forms a pleasant, easy-rinse lather. The skin is soft and delicately fragranced.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette Travel Spray, 10ml
listings.description: Feel the heat. The original cult fragrance now has an all-new look. Alluring and sexy. The velvety texture of the Tiare Flower is showcased along with creamy Coconut and the radiant warmth of Amber, Sandalwood and Vanilla. All heat. All desire. All woman. Enjoy sensuous notes of Vetiver and Myrrh, fused with warm Mandarin, Sicilian Bergamot and Lemon. Radiant notes of Jasmine and Magnolia petals will evoke your senses endlessly. How to use: Spray all over body whenever you want to surround yourself with endless summer.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique My Happy Peony Picnic Eau de Parfum, 15ml
listings.description: A fragrance romantic like an afternoon stroll in the park. Wander in a sun-drenched flower garden where giant blooming peonies and roses refuse to be ignored. A Floral Fruity scent to wear alone or layer. Notes: Black Currant Buds, Strawberry, Passion Fruit, Peony, Rose, Plum, Cedar, Amberwood, Vanilla Style: Romantic. Floral. Infectious How to use: No rules. Wear alone or collect the other My Happy™ fragrances to layer.

listings.rawTitle: Fragrance Du Bois Wild Orange Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Wild Orange is a revitalising symphony of spirited woody citrus notes, encapsulating the very soul of springtime blooms on an orange tree. A triumvirate of dominant fruity notes, mandarin, orange and bergamot, alongside the lively zest of lemon, creates a vivid and invigorating opening that evokes the force and vitality of the emerging blooms. The journey then delves into the untamed allure of wild orange blossoms and the gentle nodding heads of lily of the valley. The cool, resinous wood tones of cypress beautifully counterbalance these heady white florals, establishing a harmonious equilibrium. The fragrance's heart is further enhanced by a comforting, warm woody dry-down, where sandalwood's creamy warmth and cedarwood's aromatic embrace are grounded by the steadfast presence of vetiver and patchouli, rounding out this Citrus-Floral-Woody perfume that delights, revives and invigorates the senses. As refreshingly untamed as its namesake, it captures the essence of citrus freshness, floral elegance and woody depth, and is a perfect homage to the wide-ranging versatility of the orange family.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Les Infusions de Prada Iris Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Each Infusion fragrance in the Prada collection, is a poetic interpretation of a single, natural ingredient. Soft and elegant, Infusion D'Iris Eau de Parfum, delicately recaptures the beauty of iris, creating an elegant, modern, and unique, unisex composition. This charming fragrance combines subtle notes of powdery Iris with fresh mandarin, Tunisian neroli. The base is then warmed with subtly sweet notes of benzoin. Available in 30ml, 50ml and 100ml sizes. The perfect gift for a loved one, or signature perfume for yourself.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Introducing Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum. An intense interpretation of the original Mr. Burberry, the fragrance captures the essence and anticipation of London at nighttime. A warm, sensual and woody scent with fresh and aromatic top notes of tarragon and comforting, spicy cinnamon, layered delicately on rich patchouli with a base of amber and smokey vetiver. The bottle honours the black Heritage Trench Coat and its signature design details. Bold and masculine, the weighted cap references horn-look buttons, while a hand-tied knot in English-woven gabardine sits around the neck, celebrating the innovative fabric invented by Thomas Burberry more than 100 years ago.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Universalis Cologne Forte Eau de Parfum
listings.description: The bergamot of Calabria and the softness of white musk are combined with the brightness of vaporous white flowers of sweet pea and seringa. Aqua Universalis Cologne forte Eau de Parfum symbolises pure white, transparency and a blooming and comfortable sensation of freshness. This pure breath of fresh, enveloping air is the expression of the palette of emotions induced by light. This musky citrus fragrance spreads its blooming and comfortable sensation of freshness through the oil of bergamot from Italy and the oil of rose from Bulgaria. Notes: Bergamot oil from Italy, Damascena rose oil from Bulgaria, white floral accord (mock orange, sweet peas), white musk accord. Family: Musky Citrus.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Allegra Magnifying Rose Essence Eau de Parfum, 40m
listings.description: The enchanting Magnifying Rose essence maximises the floralcy of your Eau de Parfum. The floral essence of Magnifying Rose entices with a velvety, voluptuous intensity. Unlike a classic, powdery Rose, this blend of Bulgarian and Turkish Roses boasts a remarkable radiance, thanks to a unique fragmentation of essential oils with an unusual distillation. With a sparkle refined by subtle woody notes, Magnifying Rose delivers a luscious bouquet full of the optimism of love. Reveal a new facet of your Allegra fragrance with Magnifying Rose. #MagnifyForMore Love

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Akigala Mandarino Extrait de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Discover the essence of serenity. Akigala Mandarino is a cheerful and invigorating fragrance that perfectly balances the bright zest of citrus with warm, spicy woods. It opens with a joyful burst of fresh fruits, transitions into a festive floral heart, and settles into a passionately warm and woody finish. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Zesty Mandarin, Passion Fruit, Fresh Raspberry Heart notes: Delicate Floral Bouquet Base notes: Spicy Akigalawood, Warm Amber

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Herod Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Herod is personified by its blend of diverse notes, exuding a smoky vanilla scent. This Eau de Parfum opens on spicy top notes of cinnamon and pepper to then show its powerful heart of tobacco leaf, incense, ciste and osmanthus. These peppery notes are further surrounded by vanilla pods, musk, patchouli and woody accord at the base. An elegant and discernible perfume, for both men and women, it is the epitome of old-world sophistication. Olfactive notes: Top notes: Cinnamon, Pepper Heart notes: Tobacco Leaf, Incense, Ciste, Osmanthus Base notes: Vanilla pods, Musk, Woody accord, patchouli Herod echoes the stunning reputation of its equestrian namesake and is presented in a rich earthy-toned bottle and angular stopper. An ode to vanilla, crowned with tonka bean and sublimated with a hint of cinnamon, Herod leaves behind a delicate sillage which is both warm and bold, classic and exotic.

listings.description: The citrus Magnifying Bergamot Essence expresses the sunny energy of this gem of nature crafted by Master Perfumer Jacques Cavallier. A multi-faceted freshness. To achieve these especially bright notes, Calabrian bergamot is harvested when it’s perfectly ripe. Fresh-picked, the bergamot contains sweet and crisp notes. The Magnifying Essences are made from precious tailor-made ingredients to intensify magnificent Italian emotions. As their name suggests, these essences are highly concentrated, powerful and vibrant, an expression of true exclusivity. Beautiful worn alone, Bvlgari Allegra Magnifying essences also harmonise with any of the collection’s Eaux de Parfum to create a unique scent.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder White Linen Eau de Parfum, 60ml
listings.description: The crisp, refreshing fragrance to live in all year long. White Linen captures the very essence of a perfect day: early Spring breezes tinged with the fragrance of fresh flowers and endless blue sky. It evokes the crispness of clean sheets, the coolness of white flowers and fresh greenery. Bulgarian Rose, Violet and Orris blossoms lend a kind of natural elegance that transcends the seasons. The Inspiration: "The more complex and pressured a woman's life becomes, the more she prizes simplicity and ease. White Linen is that calming element that can lift spirits and make a woman feel cool and calm." Estée Lauder, Founder. The name White Linen came about because Mrs Lauder envisioned the woman who would wear it as fresh, crisp and clean.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum, the new masculine intensity, by Prada. The fragrance of a powerful, transformative journey to open new horizons. Built on a conviction that we can push beyond our limits, reimagining what’s possible and augmenting our performances. Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum combines intense sophistication and sensuality. Opening with an invigorating burst of grapefruit essence, contrasted with the woody vibrancy of incense and a rich Vanilla Bean accord. The bottle, inspired by the technological excellence and sleek, dynamic beauty of extreme sailing boats, echoes the power of the fragrance that lies within. Lacquered in a sophisticated deep blue, alluding to the magnetic intensity of the ocean depths. Iconised by the iconic Prada red line. An elegant, night-black cap is finished with a red dot, a symbolic reference to Luna Rossa, the red moon. Jake Gyllenhaal, the face of Prada Luna Rossa Ocean. The incarnation of the modern adventurer. A man combining physical and intellectual strength with an understanding of technology and innovation. Mastering it to better himself and his craft, in full awareness of his own limits, yet eager to push them beyond.

Highly distinctive with a fragrant woody aroma based on the unique olfactory properties of precious natural ingredients and the latest generation of molecules. New and exquisite qualities of natural citrus, bergamot and grapefruit combine with modern hints of fig leaf to give an incisive, Mediterranean freshness. Aquatic notes lend depth and round off the citrus tang. Violet leaves with a dash of black pepper add another virile dimension. But the sophisticated and innovative woody notes of ambrox, papyrus and organic patchouli form the perfume's powerful, pulsating heart.

listings.description: Introducing a new olfactive family, Kilian Hennessy pays tribute to his heritage, as heir to the renowned French cognac-making family, and to his choice olfactory intoxicants for driving the night towards dawn. The perfume: Much like a master perfumer who crafts accords and essences in a perfume, a master blender combines the eaux-de-vie in perfect proportions for an exceptional cognac. Angels’ Share contains the essence of cognac derived from the liquor to lend it a natural caramel colour. Opening with cognac oil, upon a blend of oak absolute, cinnamon essence and tonka bean absolute, the scent’s long-lasting notes of sandalwood, praline and vanilla make for a delicious finish, a rare concoction only angels should experience. Perfumer: Benoist Lapouza. True luxury should last a lifetime, and as such, all by KILIAN PARIS fragrance bottles are designed to be refilled. The cutting-edge dispenser will stop transferring the perfume automatically once the container is full. This innovative new 100ml refill allows an easy spill-proof process for your 50ml fragrance bottle, your travel spray, or your carafes.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Absolue L'Extrait Cream, 50ml
listings.description: The Elixir Cream is powered by Lancome's latest innovation Absolue Blackbiosis™, to help restore skin's youthful vitality. Now infused with our state-of-the-art Elixir Cream to envelop your skin in a velvet veil. After use, your skin’s youthful vitality is restored, skin texture is refined and skin’s density is revived, helping to improve your overall skin radiance and a reduction in the appearance of fine lines. listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Luce di Rosa Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Luce di Rosa is the sublimation of a contemporary and dynamic rose sculpted by light that counters mineral sharpness with a chiaroscuro effect, giving life to a multifaceted gender-neutral scent whose vibrant, clean, and bright notes are reminiscent of a symphony that alternates between piano and forte, adagio and vivace. Luce di Rosa, an embodiment of contrasts and dynamism, is a gender-neutral Signatures of the Sun fragrance that illuminates the essence of rose with the unexpected prism of vibrant sophistication. A fragrance sculpted by light that unfolds like a radiant glow, blending luminous citrus notes with warm undertones. The fragrance opens with an invigorating citrus blend, where Bergamot and Mandarin intertwine and is heightened by the spicy nuances of fresh Black Pepper and Pink Pepper CO2 extract, alongside the subtle accents of Cardamom Oil. At its heart, Luce di Rosa flourishes with the noble Bulgarian Rose Oil, the centrepiece of this olfactive masterpiece, extracted through steam-water distillation to capture the essence of the rose at its most vibrant, with a unique olfactory profile that is rosy, green, and spicy, with hints of honey. This dynamic rose is complemented by the verdant Geranium Oil, creating a floral and profoundly rich core. In the base, Luce di Rosa settles into a deep, grounding essence of Vetiver, Guaiac Wood, and Cedarwood, all enveloped by the soft, sensual embrace of Musk nuances, crafting a finale that unveils and reflects ever-different sensations over time.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Cuir Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Sublime and refined, yet with a timelessly rebellious edge, nothing spells YSL better than leather. Its provocative signature finds its most elegant expression with the ultimate luxury in fragrance: Oud wood, as deep, dark and intense as the blackest leather. The olfaction: Today, with Cuir, the precious couture material expresses its innate power through an ingredient more precious than gold: sublime oud. Deep, dark and intense as the blackest leather. The epitome of refinement and animal magnetism. To fully express the rebellious elegance of YSL leather, Master Perfumer Fabrice Pellegrin has selected "a true gem." This priceless oud has leathery, animalic, elegant, woody and ambery facets. "Because I was born in Grasse, I have a special relationship with these sorts of ingredients", he explains, "and I am always seeking out new olfactory profiles. When I first discovered it years ago, oud was a true revelation. For me, it is the woody note of tomorrow." With Cuir, he has given the classic ingredient a strikingly edgy twist, matching it with a wholly unexpected partner: violet leaf. "The texture and patina of oud are lightened and enhanced by the violet leaf note, whose sensation is tinged with floral softness," Fabrice Pellegrin explains. Strikingly elegant, modern, CUIR feels just as sleek, tough and sexy as a sharply tailored black leather blazer or trench. Fragrance family: Woody Leathery. Top notes: Mandarine Essence, Cardamom Essence, Violet Leaf Absolu Heart notes: Clove Essence, Oud Assafi Essence, Suede Accord Base notes: Patchouli Heart, Cedarwood Heart, Bourbon Vanilla, Sandalwood Heart The inspiration: In 1960, Yves Saint Laurent, playing by his own rules, was the first to send a black leather jacket on a couture runway, in a disruptive collection. From the Swinging Sixties to the 21st century, leather has remained one of Yves Saint Laurent’s most provocative signatures. A sex symbol that can hug skin erotically or sheath the body like armour. Playing on the tension between tough masculinity and feminine sensuality. Morphing from rock icon to timeless elegance without losing any of its rebellious edge. Leather embodies the captivating duality of the YSL style. Tough yet tender, rebellious yet elegant, resulting in a look of powerful grace. From innovative cutting techniques to unexpected colour palettes, YSL sublimes this classic material, ensuring its relevance in the ever-evolving world of fashion. Leather is more than just a material for YSL; it is the incarnation of the brand's spirit: innovation and empowerment. It's the perfect medium for expressing the sublime, elegant, and rebellious attitude that defines Yves Saint Laurent.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Rose Amira Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: The Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Rose Amira, a nocturnal tribute to the queen of flowers, an essential scent and perfumery icon. In this journey to the heart of a Persian garden, rose reveals its most sensual fragrance. Shot through with the sacred swirls of frankincense and the warmth of patchouli, the majestic flower unfolds with a blend of strength and softness in a halo of musks. "Rose Amira is my vision of rose, sumptuous and sensual within the secrecy of the night. A rose stood upright, turned towards the moon, within a poetic, nocturnal fragrance." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts by moonlight. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, Absolus Allegoria fragrances contain up to 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Rose Amira comes in the Allegoria collection’s emblematic bottle which is made in France using 15% recycled glass. Featuring a removable spray pump and transparent lacquer finish, its design can be easily recycled. *90% to 94% of ingredients are of natural origin, in accordance with ISO 16128. Calculation includes water.

Made by us at our textile factory in Lancashire Since 1953, our expert Partners have designed and manufactured a range of high-quality textiles at our UK factory, Herbert Parkinson. This includes our naturally filled bedding and our Made to Measure service for curtains, blinds and cushions. Combining traditional handmade processes with state-of-the-art technology, our skilled Partners see each product through the entire creation process, ensuring it meets the design and quality standards we’re known for. It takes up to 17 Partners to make a pair of curtains or a roman blind as each is experienced in a particular part of the process, including everything from cutting and joining, to pinning and hemming, to inspecting and packing. You can be assured that your curtains or blind are being made by true experts. We want you to be as proud of it as we are.

listings.description: Inspired by the smell of a citrus peel you break between your fingers and built around Calabrian Citron oil, Cologne Cédrat lasts for long hours. A fresh, spicy character is brought by Black and Pink pepper, while Italian Bergamot and Maté Absolute Paraguay amplify a tea note trail.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Hermessence Rose Ikebana Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Rose Ikebana offers a surprising contrast between rose petals and crisp rhubarb. "Beautiful and minimalist, the traditional Japanese art of ikebana – arranging bouquets of cut flowers and leaves using very few elements – ideally corresponded to a form of expression I could transpose into a perfume. The smell of a rose early in the morning, damp, sprinkled with dew, delicate and light."- Jean-Claude Ellena. Fragrance notes: rose, rhubarb.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Another 13 Eau de Parfum Liquid Balm Rollerball, 9ml
listings.description: In 2010, Le Labo was commissioned by AnOther Magazine to work on an exclusive scent. This project was born thanks to Sarah of colette who initiated the creative collaboration between Le Labo and Jefferson Hack, editor-in-chief of AnOther Magazine. The result of this collaboration is AnOther 13, a hypnotizing and unique scent. It’s composed of ambroxan, a synthetic animal musk, making AnOther 13 an addictive dirty potion blended with twelve other ingredients such as jasmine, moss and ambrette seeds absolute - which gives it spike and shine. As the entire planet knows, colette closed their doors December 2017, but luckily we were able to welcome AnOther 13 to our classic collection in our labs worldwide. Le Labo is proud to introduce its Liquid Balm. This new travel-friendly perfume rollerball glass vial can be used as an olfactive marker, to roll on your skin or someone else's your favourite Le Labo perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Histoires de Parfums This Is Not A Blue Bottle 1/3 Eau de Parfum, 60ml
listings.description: This is the perfume of fire. This is a molten ring, the dawning of a new energy. A Bloody Orange sun rises over Rose and Saffron’s blazing circle, liberating Leather’s endless power. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Blood Orange Heart notes: Rose, Saffron Base notes: Patchouli, Leather

listings.rawTitle: Chantecaille Frangipane Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Frangipane, native to Peru and the West Indies, was discovered by the botanist Frangipani when he landed on Antigua with the expedition of Columbus. Known by various civilisations as 'the eternal perfume', the sweet, calming fragrance is exuded by waxy yellow or pink blossoms. Uniquely sweet, full and rounded. Deeply sensual, intense and spiritual. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Orange, violet leaves, water hyacinth Mid notes: Muguet, frangipani, ylang ylang, jasmine Dry down: Vanilla, musk, cedarwood, amber

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Limited Edition Aqua Allegoria Perle Nerolia Vetiver Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Nerolia Vetiver Perle, the first micro-pearl eau de parfum*. Designed to be halfway between fragrance and skincare, Nerolia Vetiver Perle captures the floral radiance of neroli in an innovative water-based micro-pearl formula. This pioneering technology* combines the intensity of highly concentrated perfume micro-pearls with the hydrating effects of an alcohol-free aqueous base. Exalted by the freshness of water, Nerolia Vetiver has been reinvented. Calabrian neroli** becomes water- and sun-drenched on contact with the zesty accents of bergamot and the aromatic notes of basil. Infused with orange blossom water, the composition highlights neroli’s greenest facets, beautifully enhanced by the generosity of a fig note and the woody depth of a vetiver accord. A fresh and luminous neroli, radiant with light. Perfumes that become one with skin, Aqua Allegoria Perle fragrances combine the intensity of an Eau de Parfum with the effect of hydrating skincare. In this new-generation water-based fragrance*, the perfume is captured inside micro-pearls composed of naturally-derived alginate in an alcohol-free aqueous base. Enriched with plant-based glycerine, its gel texture melts into skin in a single step. It leaves a soft and velvety veil with beautifying and hydrating effects on the skin. *At Guerlain. **In a Turkish neroli and Calabrian neroli duo. How to use: A highly sensory new perfume step. Sprayed onto pulse points, the neck, décolleté and wrists, the perfume is diffused in a generous mist. Its soft and enveloping texture melts onto skin when lightly massaged in circular movements.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Chance Eau Splendide Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: A luminous new CHANCE that dazzles with splendour. CHANCE EAU SPLENDIDE, a magnetic fragrance that releases an olfactory whirlwind, diffusing a fruity-floral fragrance trail that is captivating and elegant. How to use: To express the full intensity of the interpretation, apply a generous sweeping spray of CHANCE EAU SPLENDIDE Eau de Parfum at the base of the neck, on the right, then on the left. The secret touch: apply a touch of fragrance to the nape of the neck, under the hair. Also, apply to the inside of clothing to increase the fragrance trail and make your presence felt. "When I leave my jacket behind, everyone knows that it's mine" Gabrielle Chanel.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau d'Hermès Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: The first fragrance by Hermès. A powerful and sensual eau, rich in citrus fruit and enhanced with spices. Created in 1951 by Edmond Roudnitska, Eau d’Hermès explores a citrussy, spicy, floral theme and is the house's original fragrance. It draws inspiration from the idea of a magical, deeply sensory, aroma: "The inside of a Hermès bag where the scent of a perfume lingered...A note of fine leather wrapped in fresh trails of citrus fruit, seasoned with spices," was how the perfumer-composer described it at the time. A historical novel, inspired by the tradition and culture of Hermès, it appeals to both men and women. Powerful, sensual writing.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 40 Hair & Body Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: Silk to skin. Sultry and delicate, this warm floral fragrance pulls you in with a sheer touch of sophisticated sensuality. Give in to alluring notes of Black Amber plum, jasmine blooms, and vanilla woods. Feels like the pleasure's all yours. Cheirosa 40 Perfume Mist is inspired by the excitement of 1840 when Rio debuted the legendary bailes Carnaval Ball. All are invited. How to use: Spritz from head to toe - anytime and anywhere. (May cause compliments).

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires Insolence Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Insolence is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by five generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Insolence is a spark in the eyes, an intrepid smile. Insolence is a careless grace, an ironic elegance, an amused silence. Created in 2006, Insolence celebrates this surprising, free and daring femininity. An impertinent creation with powder hints which is built around a floral violet and iris duo with orange blossom. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Vanilla Scotch Cologne 30ml
listings.description: A festive adventure in the Highlands. Warm, indulgent vanilla blended with a spirited splash of a Scotch whisky accord, tumbling over roasted tonka bean and wrapped in the sensual allure of golden amber. Presented in a special festive glass design. How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points. Your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another cologne or your favourite bath & body products.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by the inimitable Parisian style, La Petite Robe Noire is an ode to freedom and love, the embodiment of elegance and style, an invitation to joie de vivre and irreverence. A characterful fragrance trail embroidered with the most beautiful black notes in perfumery. The iconic rose of La Petite Robe Noire, embroidered with tangy fruity notes, returns more sparkling than ever. Like a breath of fresh air, sparkling bergamot reveals all the freshness of the rose. White amber combined with white musk brings softness and comfort to this delicate, floral, fresh and tender trail. The symbolic silhouette has left the streets of Paris for the first time to wander through the rose fields of Grasse, a true gem of the House's perfumers' palette. Cultivated on the Mas des Sources estate, a new organically grown rose has been added to the Eau de Toilette La Petite Robe Noire formula, with 90% of its ingredients of natural origin*: the Centifolia rose from Grasse. La Petite Robe Noire fragrances are now made using French beetroot alcohol from sustainable agriculture. Created in 1912, the 'inverted heart' bottle is an iconic symbol of the Maison Guerlain. For La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Toilette, its timeless lines are adorned in a soft pink that pays tribute to the freshness and softness of the rose. Guerlain's commitment extends to its emblematic inverted heart bottle, which now incorporates at least 15% recycled glass. *In accordance with ISO 16128, calculation including water. How to use: Spray your La Petite Robe Noire fragrance generously on the neck and pulse points to create an intense and assertive sillage. Extend your La Petite Robe Noire fragrance ritual with bath and body products. Irresistible perfumed creations, embroidered with the most beautiful black notes of perfumery.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: About the fragrance: Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum, the newest Prada Women's fragrance. This 2024 crafted signature scent is a testament to florality that expands the boundaries of sensory perception. This unique fresh and floral signature is augmented by Artificial Intelligence that enables perfumers to explore new possibilities and express their creativity, and compose new and unexpected accords with a jasmine accord. Fragrance description: Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum is a floral musky fragrance that captures the airy floral scent of Jasmine as perceived in nature. The avant-garde signature reveals fresh and zesty top notes of Italian Vert de Bergamot, a lively flowery heart incorporating Jasmine accord and Neroli, and base notes of Musk and Ambrette for comfort. This feminine Eau de Parfum is ideal for Spring and Summer with its fresh and floral olfactive profile and impressive longevity. The bottle: Like the original signature, Paradoxe Virtual Flower’s bottle expresses the House’s essence of reinvention and preference for contrasts. A minimal and delicate design at first glance, inspired by the iconic Prada triangle logo, is designed to rest on its side. Prada’s coat of arms logo contrasts with the fresh light pink colour of the fragrance. The refillable perfume bottle is finished with ‘Virtual Flower’ on its top chamfer. Fragrance family: Fresh Floral. Key notes: Jasmine, Neroli, Musk and Ambrette, Vert de Bergamot. How to use: Fragrance is intensified by the warmth of your own body. Apply in the creases of your knees and elbows for a strong and long lasting perfume scent. If you prefer placing fragrance on your wrists, be sure to reapply after frequent hand-washing, as this tends to rinse off the scent. After applying your fragrance, avoid rubbing or dabbing skin. This breaks down the fragrance, causing it to wear off more quickly.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Lavanda Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Lavanda, a sunny perfume for women by Quentin Bisch. This Provençal Eau de Parfum was inspired by Quentin Bisch's childhood vision of his mother walking from the heat of the garden into the cool of the house, a spray of lavender in her arms. Bisch revisits this note with a highly modern twist while enhancing every facet of lavender, from aromatic freshness to sun-drenched fullness. Capturing light and shade, this is the perfect summer fragrance. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Lavanda with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

listings.description: Issey Miyake Le Sel d’Issey Parfum 10ml Gift with Purchase* Gift: Issey Miyake Le Sel d’Issey Parfum, 10ml *Free with the purchase of specified Issey Miyake fragrance bundles. While stocks last. Subject to availability. Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette, 200ml Discover L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme, a truly timeless fragrance. As Issey Miyake's first perfume for men, L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme has established itself as a signature reference in the world of men's perfumery and aftershave. Strength and balance – these are the two qualities that unite the fragrance. Upon first spritz, you're greeted with the vibrant freshness of yuzu, the iconic Japanese citrus, and tangerine. In the heart, water lily creates the aquatic facet of L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme, balanced by warm spicy notes. Tobacco, vetiver, and sandalwood channel an energy which evokes that of a powerful waterfall, making the fragrance assertive and masculine. listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Cedrus de Nuit Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Les Fleurs de Nuit by Chloé Atelier des Fleurs draws inspiration from the nights of the Rive Gauche, a timeless setting where creative effervescence meets Parisian audacity. True to the philosophy of the Maison Chloé and its founder Gaby Aghion, this collection offers a sensual portrait of iconic flowers that transform at nightfall. By day, they absorb the warmth and luminosity of the sun. By night, they fully bloom, revealing the richness and singularity of secret notes, voluptuous and narcotic, that emerge only in the shadow of night. With Atelier des Fleurs Cedrus de Nuit, perfumers Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner reinvent Cedrus by highlighting a flower both rare and ephemeral: the Queen of the Night, which sets ablaze the woody heart of the iconic perfume. Once a year, this white flower awakens and blooms in darkness, releasing a voluptuous aroma like a warm exhale in the cool night air. Through an unprecedented extraction process that faithfully captures the essence of a flower in its environment, its honeyed and subtly spiced scent is immortalised in all its intensity. Amplified by an amber base, then enhanced by a dark vanilla absolute and a resinous benzoin, the sensual intensity of the flower meets the enveloping warmth of woods. The Cedrus de Nuit bottle features a deep cobalt blue, evoking a midnight sky. Its undulated glass shape pays homage to the plissé soleil, the signature of Atelier des Fleurs fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Intensa Eau de Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Vibrant, charismatic, and confident. Colonia Intensa exudes the essence of Italian light and life. Presented in a new restyled bottle, it is an exciting fragrance that combines traditional and contemporary sophistication. An olfactory style that conveys confidence and determination. The citrus woody fragrance opens with the classic citrus notes of Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian lemon. Spicy hints of cardamom and ginger lend a self-assuring character to the aromatic accents of myrtle and artemisia and the sunny notes of neroli, to then reveal the singularity of this Eau de Cologne in the base. The intense woody-leather accord and deep accents of cedarwood, patchouli, benzoin and musk define this fragrance crafted for those who don't like to hide their resolute characters and reflect self-assurance. The fragrance comes in the quintessential Acqua di Parma bottle, an epitome of the Art Deco expression. The transparent glass allows Colonia Intensa’s nuances to be fully appreciated, while the classic black cap adds a touch of understated sophistication. The restyled minimal white labels echo the refined aesthetics of the Colonia collection, while the matte-paper box, characterised by its cylinder shape, features our signature vibrant yellow shade.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci the Alchemist's Garden Lignum Idealis Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden reimagines the four stages of ancient alchemy. The Ignis stage: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden Lignum Idealis Eau de Parfum unisex perfume. Lignum Idealis Eau de Parfum: A fragrant ode to two glorious trees, Sandalwood and the Giant Sequioa, captured through modern technology. Majestic. Serene. Everlasting. Fragrance family: Woody. This fragrant vision of a forest’s soul captures the lactonic, woody glory of the Giant Sequoia. The tree’s spicy essence is preserved through an exclusive extract obtained with modern headspace technology. Utilising a biotechnology fermentation process, the creamiest parts of Sandalwood are unveiled, contrasted by the spicy, aromatic edge of a Juniper Berries Essence. A strong trail of maximum power. The bottle: Lignum Idealis Eau de Parfum’s red glass bottle is adorned with a golden deer: a creature that guards the realm of these grand trees. Olfactive alchemists: Perfumer Alexis Grugeon created this exceptional Woody Gucci scent through the mysterious technique of headspace. Gathering only the fleeting molecules surrounding the Giant Sequoia, its woody essence transports the senses while leaving the forest unharmed.

listings.description: A precious, heady Eau de Parfum, heightened with deep, rich saffron, black tea, vanilla and oud notes from the East. Delve deep into the mysteries of Assam and evoke a beautifully resinous, woody vision. The fragrance: Top notes of davana, bergamot, black pepper and cardamom A heart of saffron, rose, black tea and vanilla A base of oud, honey, tobacco and styrax resin Olfactive Signature: Olibanum Resin. Fragrance family: Woody. Explore: London via Assam. The burnished sienna façade of Talatal Ghar palace commands the golden twilight. Inside, a heady infusion of resinous olibanum, styrax and opulent oud swings majestically from gilt-edged incense burners. Labyrinthine galleries are fit for a King in their intricate resplendence. Delve into the myriad mysteries of Assam. Precious. Heady. Mesmerising.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin Sur La Lagune Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Un Jardin sur la Lagune Eau de Toilette was created in 2019 by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel. A secret garden in which nature has stood the test of time, it evokes a mysterious place in the city of a thousand contrasts: Venice. A floral and woody composition, Un Jardin sur la Lagune Eau de Toilette blends radiant magnolia, enveloping pittosporum and a carnal Madonna lily. The bottle echoes the lanterns of horse-drawn carriages and was created by Fred Rawyler. Its glass is in a delicate Venetian ochre gradient, echoing the wall that surrounds this garden. On the box, lush nature, observed from the lagoon’s waters, emerges in touches of colour, painted by artist Safet Zec. The Parfums-Jardins Collection: The Parfums-Jardins collection brings together the soul of a place, the perfumer's inspiration and the Hermès annual theme. They are olfactory strolls to indulge every desire for freshness, reverie or escape.

listings.description: Molecule 05 consists of Cashmeran, pure and singular. Cashmeran is one of the greats of synthetic chemistry. Warm and woody, with a resinous pine note. It has an unusually complex character for a single molecule. It combines a cocooning, musky softness with a dry, aromatic woodiness and a sweet resinous pine note. Cashmeran was created in a laboratory at the IFF in the late 1970s. A smooth and musky scent that merges with your skin chemistry, Molecule 05 is a scent that glorifies fragrance's undefinable magnetism and gives it its rightful due as a subtle yet requisite element in our lives that stimulates all the senses. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Fantasies Soul of the Forest Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Let yourself be drawn into the deepest whispers at the heart of the forest. Be absorbed by Soul of the Forest’s sylvan fantasy, to search for and find the forest's soul through this powerful trail. Born from the imagination of Perfumers, each of the surreal ingredients within the Replica Fantasies fragrances fuses together refined raw materials to create a new, imaginary olfactory note. Soul of the Forest’s evocative scent is defined by a surreal ingredient at its heart, the Mystical Wood. Its deep woody note captures the intangible sensation of connecting with the soul of an otherworldly woodland, and the sense of eternity elicited by encountering this enigmatic forest’s essence. The new Replica Fantasies bottle is now dressed in an opulent, graduated black lacquering. This rich hue evokes nightfall, symbolic of how the REPLICA FANTASIES fragrances usher you into a world of dreams and fantasies. Fashioned in weighted glass, the flacon is sealed at its neck with a deep black rope. A gleaming, textured silver label adorns the bottle, with its shifting iridescence conjuring how night creates a transformative passage to dreams. Key ingredients: To create this surreal ingredient, Master Perfumer Quentin Bischhas has drawn on his creativity to shape some of the finest olfactory ingredients. Cedarwood Atlas essence, whose dry, vertical wood structure evokes a mood of grandeur and wisdom. Its scent captures wandering amongst imposing, ancient trees that soar toward the sky. Then, patchouli essence, an earthy scent with rich, woody inflections and camphorous notes, echoes the inherent mysticality of a forest, adding depth to the fragrance. Finally, a moss accord, created by the perfumer himself to evoke the forest sensation of the earthy, almost damp, moss-covered ground beneath your feet, creating a profound connection with nature.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense
listings.description: The new The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense is the latest fragrance from Dolce & Gabbana The Only One line. This sophisticated and flAmber fragrance introduces a unique combination of fresh top notes from Italian mandarin, crispy green apple and golden neroli essence, blended with romantic scents of gold orange blossom and jasmine flowers, amplified with hypnotising base notes of black vanilla. The composition symbolises the mesmerising allure and irresistible sensuality of The Only One woman, wrapped in an elegant black and gold bottle. The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense is the latest chapter of The Only One fragrance line from Dolce & Gabbana. It started with The Only One Eau de Parfum, a flAmber fragrance with a modern sensuality. Then came The Only One 2 Eau de Parfum, which conjures addictive notes with a red roses heart. Now, with this latest edition, The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense celebrates the most fascinating qualities of The Only One woman with an irresistible and hypnotic fragrance. The Fragrance: The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense builds on the sophisticated fusion of floral and Amber notes. Alluringly feminine and irresistibly seductive, its unique signature scent lies in the surprising combination of dazzling gold orange blossom contrasted with hypnotizing black vanilla, to create an intense and solar sensuality. The Ingredients: Top notes come from the association of sparkling Italian mandarin and crispy green apple mixed with golden neroli essence illuminate the radiant floral heart of the fragrance. Notes of white flowers, such as gold orange blossom and jasmine absolute, softly enveloped by creamy, lush coconut essence, lend a warm and sensuous aura to the scent. Sweet, warm base notes of dark vanilla amplify the addictive quality of this fragrance, reinforced by woody notes of cedar and cashmere. The Packaging: Maintaining the graphic architectural form of The Only One collection, The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense bottle is now dressed in glamorous black, the iconic colour of Dolce & Gabbana, to reflect the hypnotic intensity of the fragrance within. The gold ring detail evokes the radiant elegance of The Only One woman, while the sinuous cursive script conjures her seductive silhouette. Fragrance Family: FlAmber. Top Notes: Italian Mandarin, Crispy Green Apple, Neroli Essence Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Coconut Base Notes: Dark Vanilla, Cedarwood, Cashmere

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani / Privé Oud Royal Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: In the hands of a Master. Discover a mystical fragrance that showcases the precious oud wood and oud oil of the Middle East. To preserve their unique characteristics, Giorgio Armani decided to work with oud oil in a luxury fragrance the same way he would approach a rich gold and silver brocade. "With Oud Royal, I wanted to capture the spirit of Eastern alchemy by elevating oud wood, the precious symbol of the Orient itself. Treating it as a piece of jewellery is the only way to do justice to its magnificent richness."

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Earl Grey & Cucumber Cologne, 100ml
listings.description: A British tradition... afternoon tea. A fragrance with a burst of bergamot, distinct to Earl Grey, and the cool succulence of crunchy cucumber. Counterpoised with a sweet base of beeswax, vanilla and musk. Reviving and refined. How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points – your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another Cologne or your favourite Bath & Body products. Your Jo Malone London order will be exquisitely wrapped in their iconic box, tied with a beautiful grosgrain ribbon. Looking to find your new favourite scent in person? Visit our Jo Malone London boutiques inside selected John Lewis & Partners shops: Cheadle Chelmsford Cribbs Causeway Edinburgh Exeter High Wycombe Horsham Milton Keynes Oxford Street Reading Southampton Stratford White City

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Under the Stars Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Under the Stars evokes the memory of a starry night spent in the wild. Its timeless blend of Oud essence and Labdanum resinoid notes recalls a dark, mystical night. Oud captures the night’s mysteries, as this precious wood creates an otherworldly effect when burning. Labdanum, meanwhile, is a warm and ambery ingredient that conjures the warmth of a summer wind caressing the skin. A raw and wild leather accord brings an element of untamed nature to Under the Stars. And Black Pepper essence highlights the captivating experience of immersing oneself in nature. How to use: As damp skin locks in the scent, apply the fragrance straight after showering or bathing and before getting dressed. Apply the fragrance on your pulse points for a more seductive effect and a stronger diffusion. Spray the fragrance from at least 15-20 centimetres from the area of application. For a more diffused effect, spray the fragrance in the air and walk through it. Wait until the fragrance has dried down on your skin before smelling it. Rubbing the skin after spraying the perfume will destroy the bond and alter the scent.

Givenchy Gentleman, the ultimate in timeless elegance and refinement.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Angel's Share Paradis Extrait de Parfum Refill, 100ml
listings.description: The ultimate interpretation of Angels' Share in an intense extrait de parfum, an irresistible ode to the finest spirits. The perfume: Inspired by an exceptional liqueur aged in oak barrels, Angels' Share Paradis captures the Maison’s incomparable savoir-faire and founder Kilian Hennessy’s legacy. The emblematic essence of Angels' Share unveils a new, daring intensity with tantalising raspberry liquor and exquisite Bulgarian rose oil orpur. A lavish dose of praline accord, enriched with warm amber notes of Venezuelan tonka bean absolut, blends seamlessly to linger on the skin, leaving a captivating, sensual trail. Perfumer: Benoist Lapouza. True luxury should last a lifetime, and as such, all by KILIAN PARIS fragrance bottles are designed to be refilled. How to use: Start refilling your bottle by carefully removing the atomiser. Plug your refill bottle into your flacon and make sure to hold it vertically. The cutting-edge dispenser will stop transferring the perfume automatically once the container is full. This innovative new 100ml refill allows an easy spill-proof process for your 50ml fragrance bottle, your travel spray, or your carafes.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Osmanthus Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Osmanthus is a sun-filled interpretation of the flower's deep and sensual notes. The intense and lively fragrance combines the richness of the osmanthus flower with green mandarin and neroli oil. An artistic combination that takes you to the rock forests of South East Asia where the elusive flower blooms with a rich and powerful fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense Refillable 30ml
listings.description: We are Chloé. Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense captures the emotion and energy of Chloé through four inspiring women who embody the values of the brand. Of different ages and from different backgrounds, they are beautiful, strong, and free. Surrounded by lush nature, they change the direction of the wind itself. A breath of feminine energy spreads to the four corners of the world. A wave of joy, optimism, and freedom. The expression of the power of women according to Chloé. The Fragrance: Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense is an addictive floral fragrance for women that opens with vibrant, juicy raspberry notes, underlining the sensuality of the rose that lies beneath. As alive as if captured at any moment of the day, its strong fragrance evokes at once the fresh morning rose, green and slightly crisp, the open midday rose, rich and deep, and the honeyed evening rose, with its sensual, addictive accents. Then, a bouquet of warm and ambery woods unfolds, each more concentrated than the last. Ambrox brings its musky, woody notes, Cashmeran offers its voluptuous sensuality, and cedar reinforces the fragrance’s unique character. A Chloé fragrance that's perfect for any occasion and lasts all day long. The Bottle: For L’Eau de Parfum Intense, the famous pleated Chloé perfume bottle has been given a new look, now stamped with a sleek black and ecru label for an even more modern and refined style. Its ribbon has also taken on a new, deep garnet hue, echoing the fragrance's composition and the flower at its heart. This fragrance has a vegan formula and is available in 30ml, 50ml or 100ml refillable bottles. Refill sold separately.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Glimmer Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: An amber floral Eau de Parfum fragrance with a gourmand twist. Notes of Macaron Rose Accord, Shimmering Patchouli and Amber Embrace Accord—reimagined through modern craft into a luminous, radiant scent. Fragrance family: Rich Floral. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Raspberry Mousse Accord, Orange Flower, Mandarin Oil Middle notes: Macaron Rose Accord, Rose, Vanilla Bean, Cashmeran Base notes: Shimmering Patchouli, Amber Embrace Accord, Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Tonka Bean What does Glimmer Eau de Parfum Spray smell like? First 10 seconds: Bright, sparkling and mouthwatering. Fruity-rosy raspberry, a fresh lift of mandarin, and a soft orange flower glow As it develops on your skin: Warmer and more enveloping. Macaron Rose Accord comes forward with its gourmand impression, wrapped in the radiant depth of Amber Embrace Accord and Shimmering Patchouli, with a smooth, skin-warmed softness Well into the wear: The fragrance settles into a lingering, addictive trail, a glowing blend of Amber, Patchouli, Woods and Tonka Bean notes. Still warmed by a whisper of sweetness that stays close and feels unforgettable The experience: This is the fragrance for life’s most extraordinary moments. It’s a scent not just to be worn, but to be felt, remembered, and shared. Because when you find what makes you glimmer, it lights up everyone around you. The bottle: A beautiful rectangular bottle embodies femininity and strength. Sculpted semi-circles catch and reflect each ray of light. A circular gold-tone cap adds a luminous finish.

listings.description: Discover the new Lancôme Idôle Peach’N Roses Eau de Parfum, a juicy, bold, and feminine fragrance that celebrates the vibrant confidence of modern women. Perfect for any occasion, this long-lasting fruity floral perfume leaves a radiant trail of peachy sweetness on the skin. The scent. Peachy sweetness. This irresistible scent opens with a burst of sparkling Red Berries Accord, awakening the senses with a lively freshness. At its heart, the exclusive Peach Orpur™ extract, an innovation by Givaudan, captures the luscious essence of a perfectly ripe peach - tangy, sweet, and utterly alluring. Finally, the velvety Damascena Rose Absolute envelops the composition with sensual warmth, reimagining the iconic Idôle floral signature with a juicy twist. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Red Berries Accord Heart notes: Peach Orpur™ Base notes: Damascena Rose Absolute The bottle: The elegant bottle, finished in glowing peach tones, embodies the spirit of optimism and light. Lancôme Idôle Peach’N Roses is the fragrance that makes every moment feel just peachy. How to use: 1. Apply to pulse points, wrists, neckline, and behind the ears, to let the fragrance bloom naturally 2. Allow the fragrance to develop naturally on the skin, and reapply as desired for more intensity 3. Perfect for day or evening wear and ideal for layering with other Idôle fragrances

Rugged yet refined, Eternity Calvin Klein Eau de Parfum is the essence of today’s confident, contemporary man.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Rose Naturelle Eau de Parfum, Refillable, 100ml
listings.description: Chloé introduces Rose Naturelle Eau de Parfum, formulated with a 100% natural origin fragrance that combines luxury and nature in a perfume fragrance. Rose Naturelle is a fresh, floral and woody refillable Eau de Parfum for women with a vegan formulation and organic rose at its heart. Exuding the modern scent of organic rose, Rose Naturelle Eau de Parfum for women is an irresistibly floral perfume, connecting the strength and spontaneity of nature with that of the free-spirited Chloé girl. Effortlessly elegant, as well as authentic and aware, she lives in harmony with the natural environment she cherishes and that inspires her. This fresh and feminine scent is rooted in nature for wholesome luxury that resonates with the independent Chloé girl's lifestyle. Spritz on your wrists and neck to reveal a full expression of the graceful strength of nature. Our Eau de Pafum is formulated with 100% natural origin fragrance, alcohol and water. Nothing else. It is a vegan perfume and does not contain artificial colourants. Each gentle whisper of the emblematic and woody organic rose will remind you of a serene, natural setting that soothes and awakens the spirit. Our hand-picked rose is organically sourced, contributing to a more responsible and sustainable culture. It is the hero ingredient of this Eau de Parfum for women, opening the scent with an airy and feminine aura complemented by Moroccan neroli. Fresh and delicate cedrat essence mingles with green, sparkling blackcurrant for an assertive spirit, while base notes of cedar essence add a powerful woody facet. Sensual mimosa highlights the scent's round character and elevates the floral heart notes. Chloé now offers a new 100ml refillable bottle that can be refilled thanks to a new 150ml refill format without losing a single drop. Pursuing its initiatives towards a lower impact on the environment, recycled materials now represent 25% of the glass and 40% of the cardboard used for the box. Inspired by the Maison's iconic crêpe de chine blouse with a feminine neck tie, the timeless vintage-inspired bottle is adorned with a 100% recycled hand-tied ribbon in a new, natural shade of green. Refillable option only available on 100ml.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette has a Gun Sunny Side Up Eau de Parfum 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Burberry Her Parfum opens with delicate cherry notes. This fruity yet profound gourmand fragrance then evolves through warm amber to an elegant and enveloping vanilla complex full of contrasts. Burberry Her Parfum is the most intense fragrance in the family – daring and sophisticated. Burberry Her is the essence of freedom: the thrill of open skies, the joy of self-expression, the empowerment of following your own path. A bold scent that becomes the signature of the woman wearing it. The iconic Burberry Her bottle is presented in an opaque deep pink colour with a fully matte finish, representing the intensity and boldness of the fragrance. The packaging is adorned with more ribbons, also picking up this tone of pink and relaying the scent's intensity. How to use: Spray onto pulse points to increase the longevity of this refined Burberry Her scent, gently pressing into the skin to preserve the essence of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d’Hermes Pure Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Terre d’Hermès tells the story of man’s relationship with the earth, his humble and harmonious dialogue with nature and the elements. Jean-Claude Ellena created Terre d’Hermès Parfum in 2009, giving Terre d’Hermès a new density. Woody and warm, Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum combines enveloping cedar and sparkling grapefruit with a radiant note of shiso. To leave its imprint on the earth, the bottle rests on an orange H, echoing the colour of the fragrance. Its strong lines and metal shoulders reflect the light. Created by designer Philippe Mouquet and inspired by a bottle in a travel vanity case, the Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum bottle unveils a range of details: Hermès’ iconic saddle nail, the sliding cover, etc.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Wonderland Peony Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: For the delicate, dreamy, radiant and thoughtful. We don't like to play favourites, but we have a thing for peonies. And this sweet floral is stuffed full of them. Armfuls of peonies, pink berries and violets. A shot of cedarwood lends a woody-balsamic warmth while vetiver injects the tiniest hint of hazelnut. Sophisticated, not soft. Captivating, not cute. Ingredients: Sicilian Lemon, Pink Berries, Pink Guava, Violet, Peony Accord, Raspberry Flower, Vanilla Bean, Pink Cotton Candy, Cedarwood, Vetiver. The hero flowers: Peony, Violet, Raspberry Flower.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Barénia Perfumed Body Cream, 200ml
listings.description: Barénia is the scent of a skin, where strength and softness come together. It expresses the instinctive and captivating facets of a woman. An unstoppable woman. The embodiment of freedom. A derivative of the Eau de Parfum, the melting and enveloping texture of Barénia perfumed body cream comforts and hydrates the skin and leaves it delicately fragranced. The intoxicating signature of the butterfly lily is intertwined with the delicacy of the miracle berry. The warm trail of oakwood and the depth of patchouli underline the magnetic uniqueness of the composition.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires L’Heure Bleue 1912 Eau de Toilette, 75ml
listings.description: Heir to Guerlain’s exceptional heritage, the Les Légendaires collection pays tribute to legendary creations composed by five generations of perfumers since 1828. Inspired by a series of love stories, both real and imagined, each fragrance infused with raw materials leaves a glorious scent of emotion in its wake. Discover L’Heure Bleue 1912, the fragrance of suspended time. It’s that time of day when day embraces night and silence fully envelopes the world. An expression of harmony, a moment of stillness and grace tinted with deep blue echoed in L’Heure Bleue, composed in 1912. Painting an impressionistic olfactory canvas, Jacques Guerlain merged the accord of violet and iris with the creamy ivory of vanilla, leaving a bewitching fragrance trail of both fresh and warm nuances. Through this ambery floral, a tale of eternal love is told. In this moment of suspended time, when the night is "yet to find its star" as Jacques Guerlain described it, L’Heure Bleue marks the meeting of two soulmates destined to become one in the frisson of eternity. "The sun has just set, but night hasn’t yet fallen. Time is suspended... in a moment when man finally finds himself in harmony with the world and with light." Jacques Guerlain. With their emblematic, gem-like bottles, the famous inverted heart designed by George Chevalier, Les Légendaires transcend the passing of time, serving as immortal inspiration for the future.

listings.rawTitle: Fragrance Du Bois NY 5th Avenue Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by one of the most exciting and diverse cities in the world, this sweet and woody fragrance is an expression of the world's most upscale street, evoking the intrigue and allure of New York’s 5th Avenue in wintertime. Created by perfumer Shadi Samra, New York 5th Avenue is an unforgettable fragrance of energy and warmth where luxurious ingredients sparkle, imitating the twinkling lights illuminating dusk like fine gems. Top notes of bergamot and rose introduce the smooth, floral and spicy heart notes of sweet caramel, cold violet and woody cypriol, before a sumptuous base of vanilla, musk, cashmeran and guaiac wood envelops the wearer in an embrace of the finest ingredients to round out this energetic and inspiring Woody-Gourmand fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Sì Eau de Parfum 30ml Holiday Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: This Holiday Season, the Armani gift set dresses in silver with a magnetic red touch and a festive bow. Open your Holiday gift set and experience Armani’s timeless signatures. This Gift Set includes a full-size Sì Eau de Parfum and a travel size. Sì Eau de Parfum is soft and warm with a hint of sophisticated sweetness. Fresh, green and addictive in its initial impression, the elegance of freesia and the exquisite honey hues of rose de mai absolute make this perfume truly distinctive. The long-lasting and sensual notes of oakmoss and patchouli softly define this fragrance as a captivating modern chypre. Top notes: Fruity blackcurrant nectar Heart notes: Sweet rose de mai, freesia accord Base notes: Spicy patchouli, warm musk Sì is Italian for 'yes' and reveals the contemporary femininity of Giorgio Armani; the Sì woman has the confidence to say yes to the values that define her life. Encapsulated in a unique bottle, crafted with a unique glass-making savoir-faire, the jewel bottle is adorned with the golden Sì logo, embossed in the glass. It is a powerful statement to invite every woman to say Sì and to embrace every aspect of herself. Set contains: Sì Eau de Parfum, 30ml Sì Eau de Parfum Travel Size, 10ml
